entries.definition: (wells), one of the four cities of the Hivites who deluded Joshua into a treaty of peace with them. (Joshua 9:17) It is now el-Bireh, which stands about 10 miles north of Jerusalem.
entries.definition_ko: '우물들'이라는 뜻으로 여호수아를 속여 평화조약을 맺게 한 히위 족속 네 성읍 중 하나이며(여호수아 9:17) 오늘날 예루살렘 북쪽 약 10마일의 엘비레이다.

entries.term: Beeroth Of The Children Of Jaakan(브에롯 브네야아간)
entries.definition: the wells of the tribe of Bene-Jaakan, which formed one of the halting-places of the Israelites in the desert. (10:6) In (Numbers 33:31) the name is given as BENEJAAKAN only.
entries.definition_ko: 브네야아간 지파의 우물들로 이스라엘이 광야에서 진 친 곳 중 하나이며(신명기 10:6) 민수기 33:31에서는 브네야아간으로만 불린다.

entries.definition: (well of the oath), the name of one of the old places in Palestine which formed the southern limit of the country. There are two accounts of the origin of the name. According to the first, the well was dug by Abraham, and the name given to Judah, (Joshua 15:28) and then to Simeon, (Joshua 19:2; 1 Chronicles 4:28) In the often-quoted “from Dan even unto Beersheba,” (Judges 20:1) it represents the southern boundary of Canaan, as Dan the northern. In the time of Jerome it was still a considerable place, and still retains its ancient name—Bir es-Seba . There are at present on the spot two principal wells and five smaller ones. The two principal wells are on or close to the northern bank of the Wady es-Seba . The larger of the two, which lies to the east, is, according to Dr. Robinson, 12 1/2 feet in diameter, and at the time of his visit (April 12) was 44 1/2 feet to the surface of the water. The masonry which encloses the well extends downward 28 1/2 feet. The other well is 5 feet in diameter, and was 42 feet to the water. The curb-stones around the mouth of both wells are worn into deep grooves by the action of the ropes of so many centures. These wells are in constant use today. The five lesser wells are in a group in the bed of the wady. On some low hills north of the large wells are scattered the foundations and ruins of a town of moderate size.
entries.definition_ko: '맹세의 우물'이라는 뜻으로 팔레스타인 남쪽 경계를 이루던 오래된 지명이다. 아브라함이 우물을 팠다는 설이 전해지며, 유다(여호수아 15:28)와 시므온(여호수아 19:2)의 경계 성읍이 되었다. '단에서부터 브엘세바까지'라는 표현은 가나안 남북 경계를 나타낸다(사사기 20:1). 오늘날에도 비르 에스세바라는 이름으로 남아 있으며 두 개의 큰 우물과 다섯 개의 작은 우물이 있다.

entries.definition: (house of Ashterah), one of the two cities allotted to the sons of Gershon out of the tribe of Manasseh beyond Jordan. (Joshua 21:27) Probably identical with Ashtaroth. (1 Chronicles 6:71)
entries.definition_ko: '아스다랏의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽 므낫세 지파에서 게르손 자손에게 배정된 두 성읍 중 하나이며(여호수아 21:27) 아스다롯과 동일한 곳으로 추정된다(역대상 6:71).

entries.definition: [Locust]
entries.definition_ko: 메뚜기(LOCUST) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: Same as cattle. (Leviticus 22:19) [See Bull, Bullock]
entries.definition_ko: 가축(소)과 같은 뜻이다(레위기 22:19). 소(BULL, BULLOCK) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: The poor among the Hebrews were much favored. They were allowed to glean in the fields, and to gather whatever the land produced in the year in which it was not tilled (Leviticus 19:10; 25:5,6; 24:19) They were also invited to feasts. (14:29) and Deuteronomy 26:12The Israelite could not be an absolute pauper. His land was in alienable, except for a certain term, when it reverted to him or his posterity. And if this resource were insufficient, he could pledge the services of himself and family or a valuable sum. Those who were indigent through bodily infirmities were usually taken care of by their kindred. A beggar was sometimes seen, however, and was regarded and abhorred as a vagabond. (Psalms 109:10) In later times beggars were accustomed, it would seem, to have a fixed place at the corners of the streets, (Mark 10:46) or at the gates of the temple, (Acts 3:2) or of private houses, (Luke 16:20)
entries.definition_ko: 히브리인들 사이에서 가난한 자들은 상당히 배려받았다 — 밭에서 이삭을 주울 수 있었고 안식년의 소출을 거둘 수 있었다(레위기 19:10). 이스라엘 사람은 절대적 빈곤 상태에 빠지지 않도록 토지가 원칙적으로 양도 불가였다. 몸이 아파 가난한 이들은 대개 친족이 돌보았으나, 이따금 거지가 있었고 방랑자로 여겨져 혐오받았다(시편 109:10). 후대에는 거지들이 거리 모퉁이나(마가복음 10:46) 성전 문, 개인 집 문 앞에 자리를 정해 앉는 관습이 있었다.

entries.definition: (great beasts). There can be little or no doubt that by this word, (Job 40:15-24) the hippopotamus is intended since all the details descriptive of the behemoth accord entirely with the ascertained habits of that animal. The hippopotamus is an immense creature having a thick and square head, a large mouth often two feet broad, small eyes and ears, thick and heavy body, short legs terminated by four toes, a short tail, skin without hair except at the extremity of the tail. It inhabits nearly the whole of Africa, and has been found of the length of 17 feet. It delights in the water, but feeds on herbage on land. It is not found in Palestine, but may at one time have been a native of western Asia.
entries.definition_ko: '큰 짐승들'이라는 뜻으로(욥기 40:15-24) 하마를 가리키는 것으로 거의 확실시된다. 하마는 두껍고 각진 머리, 큰 입, 작은 눈과 귀, 두껍고 무거운 몸, 짧은 다리를 지닌 거대한 동물로 아프리카 전역에 서식하며 길이 17피트에 이르기도 한다.

entries.definition: [Weights And MeasuresAND Measures]
entries.definition_ko: 도량형(WEIGHTS AND MEASURES) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: [Baal]
entries.definition_ko: 바알(BAAL) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (destruction). • One of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar, (Genesis 14:2; 19:22) [Zoar] • Son of Beor, who reigned over Edom in the city of Dinhabah, eight generations before Saul. (Genesis 36:31-33; 1 Chronicles 1:43,44) • Eldest son of Benjamin, according to (Genesis 46:21) (Authorized Version “Belah”); (Numbers 26:38,40; 1 Chronicles 7:6; 8:1) and head of the family of the Belaites. • Son of Ahaz, a Reubenite. (1 Chronicles 5:8)
entries.definition_ko: '파괴'라는 뜻. (1) 롯의 중재로 멸망을 면한 평지의 다섯 성읍 중 하나로 이후 소알이라 불렸다(창세기 14:2). (2) 브올의 아들로 사울보다 여덟 세대 앞서 딘하바 성읍에서 에돔을 다스린 왕(창세기 36:31). (3) 베냐민의 맏아들로(창세기 46:21) 벨라 자손의 조상. (4) 르우벤 사람 아하스의 아들(역대상 5:8).

entries.definition: [Bela, 3]
entries.definition_ko: 벨라(BELA) 3번 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (Numbers 26:38) [Bela, 3]
entries.definition_ko: 벨라(BELA) 3번 항목 참조(민수기 26:38).

entries.definition: The meaning of this word as found in the Scriptures is worthlessness, and hence reckless, lawlessness. The expression son or man of Belial must be understood as meaning simply a worthless, lawless fellow. The term as used in (2 Corinthians 6:15) is generally understood as an appellative of Satan, as the personification of all that was bad.
entries.definition_ko: '무가치함'을 뜻하며 무모함, 무법함을 함축한다. '벨리알의 아들' 또는 '벨리알의 사람'은 단순히 무가치하고 무법한 자를 뜻하며 고린도후서 6:15에서는 사탄, 곧 모든 악의 인격화를 가리키는 것으로 이해된다.

entries.definition: The word occurs only in (Jeremiah 6:29) where it denotes an instrument to heat a smelting furnace. Wilkinson in “Ancient Egypt,” iii. 338, says, “They consisted of a leather, secured and fitted into a frame, from which a long pipe extended for carrying the wind to the fire. They were worked by the feet, the operator standing upon them, with one under each foot, and pressing them alternately, while he pulled up each exhausted skin with a string he held in his hand.”
entries.definition_ko: 예레미야 6:29에만 나오며 용광로에 불을 피우는 도구를 가리킨다. 가죽을 틀에 고정해 긴 관으로 바람을 불로 보내는 방식이었으며 발로 밟아 작동시켰다.

entries.definition: In (Exodus 28:33) the bells alluded to were the golden ones 72 in number, round the hem of the his priest’s ephod. The object of them was so that his sound might be heard.” (Exodus 28:34) Ecclus. 45:9. To this day bells are frequently attached, for the sake of their pleasant sound, to the anklets of women. The little girls of Cairo wear strings of them around their feet. In (Zechariah 14:20) “bells of the horses” were concave or flat pieces of brass, which were sometimes attached to horses for the sake of ornament.
entries.definition_ko: 출애굽기 28:33에는 대제사장의 에봇 옷단에 둘린 금방울 72개가 언급되며 소리가 들리게 하려는 목적이었다. 스가랴 14:20의 '말 방울'은 말에 장식으로 다는 오목하거나 납작한 놋 조각이었다.

entries.definition: (prince of Bel), the last king of Babylon. In (Daniel 5:2) Nebuchadnezzar is called the father of Belshazzar. This, of course, need only mean grandfather or ancestor. According to the well-known narrative Belshazzar gave a splendid feast in his palace during the siege of Babylon (B.C. 538), using the sacred vessels of the temple, which Nebuchadnezzer had brought from Jerusalem. The miraculous appearance of the handwriting on the wall, the calling in of Daniel to interpret its meaning the prophecy of the overthrow of the kingdom, and Belshazsar’s death, accorded in Dan. 5.
entries.definition_ko: '벨의 왕자'라는 뜻으로 바벨론의 마지막 왕이다. 다니엘 5:2에서 느부갓네살을 벨사살의 '아버지'라 부르나 이는 조부 또는 선대를 뜻하는 것으로 이해된다. 바벨론 포위(주전 538년) 중 성전의 거룩한 그릇으로 큰 잔치를 벌였으며, 벽에 나타난 신비한 손글씨를 다니엘이 해석해 왕국의 몰락을 예언했고 그날 밤 벨사살은 죽임을 당했다(다니엘 5장).

entries.definition: (favored by Bel .) [Daniel, Daniel, The Book Of]
entries.definition_ko: '벨의 은총을 입은 자'라는 뜻. 다니엘(DANIEL) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (son), a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark. (1 Chronicles 15:18)
entries.definition_ko: '아들'이라는 뜻으로 다윗이 언약궤를 위해 세운 문지기 레위인이다(역대상 15:18).

entries.definition: (made by the Lord). • The son of Jehoiada the chief priest, (1 Chronicles 27:5) of the tribe of Levi, though a native of Kabzeel, (2 Samuel 23:20) set by David, (1 Chronicles 11:25) over his body-guard. (2 Samuel 8:18; 20:23; 1 Kings 1:38; 1 Chronicles 18:17) One of the mighty men. (2 Samuel 23:22,23; 1 Chronicles 11:25; 27:6) The exploits which gave him this rank are narrated in (2 Samuel 23:20,21; 1 Chronicles 11:22) He was captain of the host for the third month. (1 Chronicles 27:5) Benaiah remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah’s attempt on the crown, (1 Kings 1:8,10,32,38,44) and was raised unto the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the whole army. (1 Kings 2:35; 4:4) (B.C. 1005.) • Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David’s thirty mighty men, (2 Samuel 23:30; 1 Chronicles 11:31) and the captain of the eleventh monthly course. (1 Chronicles 27:14) • A Levite in the time of David, who “played with a psaltry on Alamoth.” (1 Chronicles 15:18,20; 16:5) • A priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark. (1 Chronicles 15:24; 16:6) • A Levite of the sons of Asaph. (2 Chronicles 20:14) • A Levite in the time of Hezekiah. (2 Chronicles 31:13) • One of the “princes” of the families of Simeon. (1 Chronicles 4:36) • Four laymen in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives. (Ezra 10:25,30,35,43) • The father of Pelatiah. (Ezekiel 11:1,13)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 지으신'이라는 뜻. (1) 대제사장 여호야다의 아들로 갑스엘 출신 레위인이며(사무엘하 23:20) 다윗의 근위대장이 되었다. 다윗의 용사 중 하나로 셋째 달의 군대장이었으며(역대상 27:5) 아도니야의 왕위 찬탈 시도 때 솔로몬에게 충성했고 요압을 대신해 군대 총사령관이 되었다(열왕기상 2:35). (2) 비라돈 사람 에브라임 지파 용사(사무엘하 23:30). (3)~(9) 레위인, 제사장, 방백 등 여러 인물.

entries.definition: (son of my people), the son of the younger daughter of Lot, and progenitor of the Ammonites. (Genesis 19:38) (B.C. 1897.)
entries.definition_ko: '내 백성의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 롯의 작은 딸이 낳은 아들이며 암몬 족속의 조상이다(창세기 19:38).

entries.definition: (son of lightning), one of the cities of the tribe of Dan, mentioned only in (Joshua 19:45)
entries.definition_ko: '번개의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 단 지파의 성읍 중 하나이며 여호수아 19:45에만 언급된다.

entries.definition: (sons of Jaakan), a tribe who gave their name to certain wells in the desert which formed one of the halting-places of the Israelites on their journey to Canaan. [Beeroth Of The Children Of JaakanBENE-JAAKAN] Also given in (Genesis 36:27) as Akan.
entries.definition_ko: '야아간의 아들들'이라는 뜻으로 광야에서 이스라엘의 진영지가 된 우물들에 이름을 붙인 부족이며(신명기 10:6) 창세기 36:27에서는 아간으로 나온다.

entries.definition: (the children of the East), an appellation given to a people or to peoples dwelling to the east of Palestine. It occurs in (Genesis 29:1; Judges 6:3,33; 7:12; 8:10; Job 1:3)
entries.definition_ko: '동방의 자녀들'이라는 뜻으로 팔레스타인 동쪽에 거주하는 민족을 가리키는 명칭이다(창세기 29:1; 사사기 6:3).

entries.definition: (son of Hadad), the name of three kings of Damascus. BENHADAD I., King of Damascus, which in his time was supreme in Syria. He made an alliance with Asa, and conquered a great part of the north of Israel. (1 Kings 15:18) His date is B.C. 950. BENHADAD II., son of the preceding, and also king of Damascus. Long wars with Israel characterized his reign. Some time after the death of Ahab, Benhadad renewed the war with Israel, attacked Samaria a second time, and pressed the siege so closely that there was a terrible famine in the city. But the Syrians broke up in the night in consequence of a sudden panic. Soon after Ben-hadad fell sick, and sent Hazael to consult Elisha as to the issue of his malady. On the day after Hazael’s return Ben-hadad was murdered, probably by some of his own servants. (2 Kings 8:7-15) Ben-hadad’s death was about B.C. 890, and he must have reigned some 30 years. BEN-HADAD III., son of Hazael, and his successor on the throne of Syria. When he succeeded to the throne, Jehoash recovered the cities which Jehoahaz had lost to the Syrians, and beat him in Aphek. (2 Kings 13:17,25) The date of Ben-hadad III is B.C. 840.
entries.definition_ko: '하닷의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 다메섹의 세 왕의 이름이다. (1) 벤하닷 1세는 아사와 동맹을 맺고 이스라엘 북부를 정복했다(열왕기상 15:18, 주전 950년경). (2) 벤하닷 2세는 아합 사후 이스라엘과 오랜 전쟁을 벌였으며 사마리아를 두 번째로 포위해 극심한 기근을 초래했으나 갑작스러운 공황으로 수리아군이 흩어졌다. 병이 들어 하사엘을 보내 엘리사에게 자문을 구했으나 하사엘이 돌아온 다음 날 살해당했다(열왕기하 8:7-15, 주전 890년경). (3) 벤하닷 3세는 하사엘의 아들이자 후계자로 요아스가 수리아에게 빼앗겼던 성읍들을 되찾고 아벡에서 그를 물리쳤다(열왕기하 13:17, 주전 840년경).

entries.definition: (son of the host, strong), one of the princes whom King Jehoshaphat sent to teach in the cities of Judah. (2 Chronicles 17:7)
entries.definition_ko: '군대의 아들, 곧 강한'이라는 뜻으로 여호사밧 왕이 유다 성읍들에 가르치도록 보낸 방백 중 하나이다(역대하 17:7).

entries.definition: (son of the gracious), son of Shimon, in the line of Judah. (1 Chronicles 4:20)
entries.definition_ko: '은혜로운 자의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 유다 계열 시몬의 아들이다(역대상 4:20).

entries.definition: (our son), a Levite; one of those who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah. (Nehemiah 10:13,14)
entries.definition_ko: '우리의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 느헤미야와 언약을 맺은 레위인 중 하나이다(느헤미야 10:13).

entries.definition: (son of the right hand, fortunate). • The youngest of the children of Jacob. His birth took place on the road between Bethel and Bethlehem, near the latter, B.C. 1729. His mother, Rachel, died in the act of giving him birth, naming him with her last breath Ben-oni (son of my sorrow). This was by Jacob changed into Benjamin. (Genesis 35:16,18) Until the journeys of Jacob’s sons and Jacob himself into Egypt we hear nothing of Benjamin. Nothing personal is known of him. Henceforward the history of Benjamin is the history of the tribe. • A man of the tribe of Benjamin, son of bilhan, and the head of a family of warriors. (1 Chronicles 7:10) • One of the “sons of Harim,” an Israelite in the time of Ezra who had married a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:32)
entries.definition_ko: '오른손의 아들, 곧 행운아'라는 뜻. (1) 야곱의 막내아들로 베들레헴 근처 벧엘로 가는 길에서 태어났으며(주전 1729년) 어머니 라헬은 그를 낳다가 죽으며 '베노니'(내 슬픔의 아들)라 이름 지었으나 야곱이 베냐민으로 바꾸었다(창세기 35:16,18). (2) 빌한의 아들로 용사 가문의 우두머리(역대상 7:10). (3) 에스라 시대 이방 아내를 얻은 하림 자손 중 하나(에스라 10:32).

entries.definition: (Jeremiah 20:2; 37:13; 38:7; Zechariah 14:10) [Jerusalem]
entries.definition_ko: 예루살렘(JERUSALEM) 항목 참조(예레미야 20:2).

entries.definition: The proximity of Benjamin to Ephraim during the march to the promised land was maintained in the territory allotted to each. That given to Benjamin formed almost a parallelogram, of about 26 miles in length by 12 in breadth, lying between Ephraim, the Jordan, Judah and Dan. The general level of this part of Palestine is not less than 2000 feet above the Mediterranean or than 3000 feet above the valley of the Jordan, the surrounding country including a large number of eminences—almost every one of which has borne some part in the history of the tribe—and many torrent beds and deep ravines.
entries.definition_ko: 베냐민 지파에 배정된 땅은 약속의 땅 진군 중 에브라임과 인접했던 관계를 그대로 반영해 길이 약 26마일, 폭 12마일의 직사각형에 가까운 형태로 에브라임, 요단강, 유다, 단 사이에 위치했다. 해발 2000피트 이상의 고지대로 여러 언덕과 급류, 협곡이 있었다.

entries.definition: The contrast between the warlike character of the tribe and the peaceful image of its progenitor comes out in many scattered notices. Benjamin was the only tribe which seems to have pursued archery to any purpose, and their skill in the bow, (1 Samuel 20:20,36; 2 Samuel 1:232; 1 Chronicles 8:40; 12:2; 2 Chronicles 17:17) and the sling, (Judges 20:16) is celebrated. The dreadful deed recorded in Judges 19was defended by Benjamin. Later the tribe seems, however, to assume another position, as Ramah, (1 Samuel 9:12) etc., Mizpeh, (1 Samuel 7:5) Bethel and Gibeon, (1 Kings 3:4) were all in the land of Benjamin. After the struggles and contests which followed the death of Saul, the history of Benjamin becomes merged in that of the southern kingdom.
entries.definition_ko: 베냐민 지파는 조상의 평화로운 이미지와 대조적으로 호전적인 성격을 지녔으며, 특히 활쏘기(사무엘상 20:20)와 물매(사사기 20:16)에 뛰어났다. 사사기 19장의 참혹한 사건을 지파 전체가 옹호했으나, 이후 라마·미스바·벧엘·기브온 등이 모두 베냐민 땅에 속하게 되었고, 사울 사후의 갈등을 거쳐 결국 남유다 왕국 역사에 편입되었다.

entries.definition: (his son), a Levite of the sons of Merari. (1 Chronicles 24:26,27)
entries.definition_ko: '그의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 므라리 가문 레위인이다(역대상 24:26).

entries.definition: (Numbers 32:3) [BETH-BAALMEON] Comp. ver. 38.
entries.definition_ko: 벧바알므온(BETH-BAALMEON) 항목 참조(민수기 32:3).

entries.definition: (son of my sorrow). (Genesis 35:18) [Benjamin, Benjamin, The Tribe Of]
entries.definition_ko: '내 슬픔의 아들'이라는 뜻이다(창세기 35:18). 베냐민(BENJAMIN) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (son of Zoheth), a descendant of Judah. (1 Chronicles 4:20)
entries.definition_ko: '소헷의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 유다의 후손이다(역대상 4:20).

entries.definition: (burning or torch). • The father of Bela, one of the early Edomite kings. (Genesis 36:32; 1 Chronicles 1:43) • Father of Balaam. (Numbers 22:5; 24:3,15; 31:8; 23:4; Joshua 13:22; 24:9; Micah 6:5) He is called Bosorin the New Testament. (B.C. before 1450.)
entries.definition_ko: '불타는 것, 곧 횃불'이라는 뜻. (1) 초기 에돔 왕 벨라의 아버지(창세기 36:32). (2) 발람의 아버지로(민수기 22:5) 신약에서는 보솔이라 불린다.

entries.definition: (son of evil) king of Sodom. (Genesis 14:2) also (Genesis 14:17,21)
entries.definition_ko: '악의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 소돔 왕이다(창세기 14:2).

entries.definition: (well watered). • A city of Macedonia, mentioned in (Acts 17:10,13) It is now called Verria or KaraVerria, and is situated on the eastern slope of the Olympian mountain range, and has 15,000 or 20,000 inhabitants. • The modern Aleppo, mentioned in 2 Macc. 13:4. • A place in Judea, apparently not very far from Jerusalem. 1 Macc. 9:4.
entries.definition_ko: '물이 풍부한'이라는 뜻. (1) 마케도니아의 도시로(사도행전 17:10) 오늘날 베리아(카라베리아)라 불리며 올림푸스 산맥 동쪽 경사면에 위치한다. (2) 오늘날의 알레포(마카베오하 13:4). (3) 예루살렘에서 멀지 않은 유대의 한 장소(마카베오상 9:4).

entries.definition: (blessing), a Benjamite who attached himself to David at Ziklag. (1 Chronicles 12:3) (B.C. 1054.)
entries.definition_ko: '복'이라는 뜻으로 시글락에서 다윗에게 합류한 베냐민 사람이다(역대상 12:3).

entries.definition: a valley in which Jehoshaphat and his people assembled to “bless” Jehovah after the overthrow of the hosts of Moabites. (2 Chronicles 20:26) It is now called Bereikut, and lies between Tekua and the main road from Bethlehem to Hebron.
entries.definition_ko: 여호사밧과 백성이 모압 군대를 물리친 후 여호와를 '찬송'하기 위해 모인 골짜기이며(역대하 20:26) 오늘날 브레이쿠트라 불리며 드고아와 베들레헴-헤브론 대로 사이에 위치한다.

entries.definition: (blessed of Jehovah), a Gershonite Levite, father of Asaph. (1 Chronicles 6:39) [Berechiah]
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께 복 받은'이라는 뜻으로 게르손 가문 레위인이며 아삽의 아버지이다(역대상 6:39). 브레갸(BERECHIAH) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (created by Jehovah), son of Shimhi, a chief man of Benjamin. (1 Chronicles 8:21)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 지으신'이라는 뜻으로 심히의 아들이며 베냐민 지파의 우두머리이다(역대상 8:21).

entries.definition: (blessed of Jehovah). • A descendant of the royal family of Judah. (1 Chronicles 3:20) • A man mentioned as the father of Meshullam, who assisted in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 3:4,30; 6:18) • A Levite. (1 Chronicles 9:16) • A doorkeeper for the ark. (1 Chronicles 15:23) • One of the tribe of Ephraim in the time of Ahaz. (2 Chronicles 28:12) • Father of Asaph the singer. (1 Chronicles 15:17) [Berachiah] • Father of Zechariah. (Zechariah 1:1,7)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께 복 받은'이라는 뜻. (1) 유다 왕실 후손(역대상 3:20). (2) 느헤미야의 성벽 재건을 도운 므술람의 아버지(느헤미야 3:4). (3) 레위인(역대상 9:16). (4) 언약궤의 문지기(역대상 15:23). (5) 아하스 시대 에브라임 지파 사람(역대하 28:12). (6) 찬양자 아삽의 아버지(역대상 15:17). (7) 스가랴의 아버지(스가랴 1:1).

entries.definition: (hail). • A place in the south of Palestine, near the well Lahairoi. (Genesis 16:14) • A son or descendant of Ephraim, (1 Chronicles 7:20) possibly identical with Becher in (Numbers 26:35)
entries.definition_ko: '우박'이라는 뜻. (1) 팔레스타인 남쪽, 브엘라해로이 우물 근처의 장소(창세기 16:14). (2) 에브라임의 아들 또는 후손으로 민수기 26:35의 베겔과 동일 인물로 추정된다(역대상 7:20).

entries.definition: [Bernice, Or Berenice]
entries.definition_ko: 버니게(BERNICE) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (a well), son of Zophah, of the tribe of Asher. (1 Chronicles 7:36)
entries.definition_ko: '우물'이라는 뜻으로 아셀 지파 소바의 아들이다(역대상 7:36).

entries.definition: (in evil, or a gift). • A son of Asher. (Genesis 46:17; Numbers 26:44,45) • A son of Ephraim. (1 Chronicles 7:20-23) • A Benjamite. (1 Chronicles 8:13,16) • A Levite. (1 Chronicles 23:10,11)
entries.definition_ko: '악한 상태에서, 곧 선물'이라는 뜻. (1) 아셀의 아들(창세기 46:17). (2) 에브라임의 아들(역대상 7:20-23). (3) 베냐민 사람(역대상 8:13). (4) 레위인(역대상 23:10).

entries.definition: A tribe of people who are named with Abel and Beth-maachah, and who were therefore doubtless situated in the north of Palestine. (2 Samuel 20:14)
entries.definition_ko: 아벨, 벧마아가와 함께 언급되는 부족으로 팔레스타인 북부에 위치했던 것으로 추정된다(사무엘하 20:14).

entries.definition: (Judges 9:46) [BAAL-BERITH]
entries.definition_ko: 바알브릿(BAAL-BERITH) 항목 참조(사사기 9:46).

entries.definition: (bringing victory), the eldest daughter of Herod Agrippa I. (Acts 12:1) etc. She was first married to her uncle Herod, king of Chaleis, and after his death (A.D. 48) she lived under circumstances of great suspicion with her own brother, Agrippa II., in connection with whom she is mentioned, (Acts 25:13,23; 26:30) as having visited Festus on his appointment as procurator of Judea.
entries.definition_ko: '승리를 가져오는'이라는 뜻으로 헤롯 아그립바 1세의 맏딸이다(사도행전 12:1). 삼촌인 갈키스 왕 헤롯과 먼저 결혼했고 그 사후에는 친오빠 아그립바 2세와 의혹스러운 관계로 지냈으며, 베스도가 유대 총독으로 부임했을 때 그와 함께 방문한 것으로 언급된다(사도행전 25:13).

entries.definition: (2 Kings 20:12) [MERODACH-BALADAN]
entries.definition_ko: 므로닥발라단(MERODACH-BALADAN) 항목 참조(열왕기하 20:12).

entries.definition: (toward the wells), Bero’-tha-i (my wells). The first of these two names is given by Ezekiel, (Ezekiel 47:16) in connection with Hahlath and Damascus as forming part of the northern boundary of the promised land. The second is mentioned, (2 Samuel 8:8) in the same connection. The well-known city Beirut (Berytus) naturally suggests itself as identical with one at least of the names; but in each instance the circumstances of the case seem to require a position farther east. They were probably in the vicinity of the springs near the present Hasbeya.
entries.definition_ko: '우물들을 향해'라는 뜻으로 에스겔이 하흘랏, 다메섹와 함께 약속의 땅 북쪽 경계의 일부로 언급하며(에스겔 47:16) 사무엘하 8:8에서는 베로대라 불린다. 오늘날의 베이루트로 추정되기도 하나 위치상 더 동쪽이어야 하며 하스베야 근처 샘 지역으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (1 Chronicles 11:39) [Beeroth Of The Children Of Jaakan]
entries.definition_ko: 브에롯브네야아간(BEEROTH OF THE CHILDREN OF JAAKAN) 항목 참조(역대상 11:39).

entries.definition: (tarshish) occurs in (Exodus 28:20) It is generally supposed that the tarshish derives its name from the place so called, in Spain. Beryl is a mineral of great hardness, and, when transparent, of much beauty. By tarshish the modern yellow topaz is probably intended, while in (Revelation 21:20) a different stone is perhaps referred to, probably the mineral now called beryl, which is identical with the emerald except in color, being a light green or bluish-green.
entries.definition_ko: 히브리어 '다시스'로(출애굽기 28:20) 서바나 지명 다시스에서 이름이 유래한 것으로 추정되며 매우 단단하고 투명할 때 아름다운 광물이다. 오늘날의 황옥으로 추정되며, 계시록 21:20의 녹주석은 에메랄드와 성분은 같으나 색이 연한 녹색 또는 청록색인 다른 보석을 가리킨다.

entries.definition: (sword). “Children of Besai” were among the Nethinim who returned to Judea with Zerubbabel. (Ezra 2:49; Nehemiah 7:52)
entries.definition_ko: '검'이라는 뜻으로 그 자손이 스룹바벨과 함께 유대로 돌아온 느디님 사람들 중 하나이다(에스라 2:49).

entries.definition: (n the secret of the Lord) father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 3:6)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와의 비밀 안에'라는 뜻으로 예루살렘 성벽 보수자 중 하나의 아버지이다(느헤미야 3:6).

entries.definition: a brush or broom of twigs for sweeping (Isaiah 14:23)
entries.definition_ko: 가지로 만든 청소용 빗자루이다(이사야 14:23).

entries.definition: (cool), a torrent-bed or wady in the extreme south of Judah. (1 Samuel 30:9,10,21)
entries.definition_ko: '시원한'이라는 뜻으로 유다 최남단의 급류 골짜기(와디)이다(사무엘상 30:9).

entries.definition: (confidence), a city belonging to Hadadezer king of Zobah, mentioned with Berothai. (2 Samuel 8:8) In the parallel account, (1 Chronicles 18:8) the name is called Tibhath.
entries.definition_ko: '신뢰'라는 뜻으로 소바 왕 하닷에셀에 속한 성읍이며 브로대와 함께 언급되고(사무엘하 8:8) 역대상 18:8에서는 디브핫이라 불린다.

entries.definition: (height), one of the cities on the border of the tribe of Asher. (Joshua 19:25)
entries.definition_ko: '높음'이라는 뜻으로 아셀 지파 경계의 성읍 중 하나이다(여호수아 19:25).

entries.definition: the most general word for a house or habitation. It has the special meaning of a temple or house of worship Beth is more frequently employed in compound names of places than any other word.
entries.definition_ko: '집'을 뜻하는 가장 일반적인 히브리어 단어로 신전이나 예배 처소를 특별히 가리키기도 하며, 다른 어떤 단어보다 지명의 복합어에 자주 사용된다.

entries.definition: (house of the ford), a place beyond Jordan, in which according to the Received Text of the New Testament, John was baptizing. (John 1:28) If this reading be correct, Bethabara is identical with Beth-barah (fords of Abarah) the ancient ford of Jordan on the road to Gilead; or, which seems more likely, with Beth-nimrah, on the east of the river, nearly opposite Jericho. The Revised Version reads Bethany, which see below.
entries.definition_ko: '나루터의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 건너편의 한 장소이며 흠정역 본문에 따르면 요한이 세례를 베푼 곳이다(요한복음 1:28). 벧바라 또는 벧님라와 동일한 곳으로 추정되며, 개정역에서는 '베다니'로 읽는다.

entries.definition: (house of echo or reply), one of the “fenced cities” of Naphtali, named with Bethshemesh, (Joshua 19:38) from neither of them were the Canaanites expelled. (Judges 1:33)).
entries.definition_ko: '메아리 또는 응답의 집'이라는 뜻으로 납달리의 요새화된 성읍 중 하나이며 벧세메스와 함께 언급되고(여호수아 19:38) 두 곳 모두 가나안 사람들을 쫓아내지 못했다(사사기 1:33).

entries.definition: (house of echo), a town in the mountainous district of Judah, named with Halhul, Beth-zur and others in (Joshua 15:58) only.
entries.definition_ko: '메아리의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다 산악 지대의 성읍이며 할훌, 벧술 등과 함께 언급된다(여호수아 15:58).

entries.definition: In the Revised Version for Bethabara, (John 1:28) where Jesus was baptized by John. It was probably an obscure village near Bethabara, and in time its name faded out and was replaced by the larger and more important Bethabara. (house of dates, or house of misery), a village which, scanty as are the notices of it contained in Scripture, is more intimately associated in our minds than perhaps any other place with the most familiar acts and scenes of the last days of the life of Christ. It was situated “at” the Mount of Olives, (Mark 11:1; Luke 19:29) about fifteen stadia (furlongs, i.e. 1 1/2 or 2 miles) from Jerusalem (John 11:18) on or near the usual road From Jericho to the city, (Luke 19:29) comp. Mark 11:1comp. Mark 10:46And close by the west(?) of another village called Bethphage, the two being several times mentioned together. Bethany was the home of Mary and Martha and Lazarus, and is now known by a name derived from Lazarus—el-Azariyeh or Lazarieh . It lies on the eastern slope of the Mount of Olives, fully a mile beyond the summit, and not very far from the point at which the road to Jericho begins its more sudden descent towards the Jordan valley. El-’Azariyeh is a ruinous and wretched village, a wild mountain hamlet of some twenty families. Bethany has been commonly explained “house of dates,” but it more probably signifies “house of misery.” H. Dixon, “Holy Land,” ii. 214, foll.
entries.definition_ko: 개정역에서 요한복음 1:28의 '벧아바라'를 '베다니'로 옮긴 것으로, 요한이 세례를 준 무명의 작은 마을로 추정된다. 또한 '대추야자의 집' 또는 '고통의 집'이라는 뜻의 마을로, 그리스도의 생애 마지막 날들과 가장 밀접하게 연관되며 감람산 근처, 예루살렘에서 약 15스타디온(2마일) 거리에 위치했다. 마리아와 마르다, 나사로의 고향이었으며 오늘날 나사로의 이름을 딴 엘아자리예로 불린다.

entries.definition: (house of the desert), one of the six cities of Judah which were situated down in the Arabah, the sunk valley of the Jordan and Dead Sea, (Joshua 15:61) on the north border of the tribe. It is also included in the list of the towns of Benjamin. (Joshua 18:22)
entries.definition_ko: '광야의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강과 사해가 만나는 저지대 아라바에 위치한 유다의 여섯 성읍 중 하나이며(여호수아 15:61) 베냐민 성읍 목록에도 포함된다(여호수아 18:22).

entries.definition: (house of the height), accurately BETH-HARAM, one of the towns of Gad on the east of Jordan, described as in “the valley,” (Joshua 13:27) and no doubt the same place as that named BETH-HARAN in (Numbers 32:36)
entries.definition_ko: '높은 곳의 집'이라는 뜻으로 정확히는 벧하람이며 요단강 동쪽 갓 지파의 도시로 '골짜기'에 있다고 묘사되고(여호수아 13:27) 민수기 32:36의 벧하란과 같은 곳으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (house of nothingness, i.e. of idols), a place on the mountains of Benjamin, east of Bethel, (Joshua 7:2; 18:12) and lying between that place and Michmash. (1 Samuel 13:5; 14:28) In (Hosea 4:15; 5:8; 10:5) the name is transferred to the neighboring Bethel,—once the “house of God” but then the house of idols of “naught.”
entries.definition_ko: '헛됨(우상)의 집'이라는 뜻으로 베냐민 산지, 벧엘 동쪽에 위치하며(여호수아 7:2) 믹마스 사이에 있다(사무엘상 13:5). 호세아서에서는 이 이름이 이웃한 벧엘, 곧 한때 '하나님의 집'이었으나 이제는 우상의 집이 된 곳을 가리키는 데 전용된다(호세아 4:15).

entries.definition: (house of Azmaveth). Under this name is mentioned, in (Nehemiah 7:28) only, the town of Benjamin which is elsewhere called Azmavethand BETH-SAMOS.
entries.definition_ko: '아스마웻의 집'이라는 뜻으로 느헤미야 7:28에만 나오며 다른 곳에서는 아스마웻 또는 벧사모스로 불리는 베냐민 성읍이다.

entries.definition: (house of Baalmeon), a place in the possessions of Reuben, on the downs (Authorized Version “plain”) east of the Jordan. (Joshua 13:17) At the Israelites’ first approach is name was BAAL-MEON, (Numbers 32:38) or, in its contracted form, BEON (Numbers 32:3) to which the Beth was possibly a Hebrew addition. Later it would seem to have come into possession of Moab, and to be known either as Beth-meon, (Jeremiah 48:23) or Baal-meon. (Ezekiel 25:9) The name is still attached to a ruined place of considerable size a short distance to the southwest of Hesban, and bearing the name of “the fortress of Mi’un, ” or Makin .
entries.definition_ko: '바알므온의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽 르우벤 지파 영토, 언덕 지대에 위치한다(여호수아 13:17). 처음에는 바알므온(민수기 32:38) 또는 축약형 브온(민수기 32:3)으로 불렸으며, 후에 모압의 소유가 되어 벧므온(예레미야 48:23) 또는 바알므온(에스겔 25:9)으로 불렸다.

entries.definition: (house of the ford), named only in (Judges 7:24) It derived its chief interest in the possibility that its more modern representative may have been Beth-abara, where John baptized. It was probably the chief ford of the district.
entries.definition_ko: '나루터의 집'이라는 뜻으로 사사기 7:24에만 나오며 요한이 세례를 베푼 벧아바라와 같은 곳일 가능성이 있어 흥미를 끈다. 이 지역의 주요 나루터였을 것으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (house of my creation), a town of Simeon, (1 Chronicles 4:31) which by comparison with the parallel list in (Joshua 19:6) appears to have had also the name Of BETHLEBAOTH. It lay to the extreme south.
entries.definition_ko: '나의 창조의 집'이라는 뜻으로 시므온 지파의 성읍이며(역대상 4:31) 여호수아 19:6의 벧르바옷과 같은 곳으로 보이며 최남단에 위치했다.

entries.definition: (house of the lamb), a place named as the point to which the Israelites pursued the Philistines, (1 Samuel 7:11) and therefore west of Mizpeh.
entries.definition_ko: '어린양의 집'이라는 뜻으로 이스라엘이 블레셋을 추격한 지점으로 언급되며(사무엘상 7:11) 미스바 서쪽에 위치한다.

entries.definition: (house of Dagon). • A city in the low country of Judah, (Joshua 15:41) and therefore not far from the Philistine territory. • A town apparently near the coast, named as one of the landmarks of the boundary of Asher. (Joshua 19:27)
entries.definition_ko: '다곤의 집'이라는 뜻. (1) 블레셋 영토와 멀지 않은 유다 저지대의 성읍(여호수아 15:41). (2) 아셀 지파 경계 표지로 언급되는 해안 근처 성읍(여호수아 19:27).

entries.definition: (house of fig-cakes), a town of Moab, (Jeremiah 48:22) apparently the place elsewhere called ALMON-DIBLATHAIM.
entries.definition_ko: '무화과 과자의 집'이라는 뜻으로 모압의 성읍이며(예레미야 48:22) 다른 곳에서는 알몬디블라다임이라 불리는 곳으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (the house of God) well known city and holy place of central Palestine, about 12 mlles north of Jerusalem. If we are to accept the precise definition of (Genesis 12:8) the name of Bethel would appear to have existed at this spot even before the arrival of Abram in Canaan. (Genesis 12:8; 13:3,4) Bethel was the scene of Jacob’s vision. (Genesis 28:11-19; 31:13) Jacob lived there. (Genesis 35:1-8) The original name was Luz. (Judges 1:22,23) After the conquest Bethel is frequently heard of. In the troubled times when there was no king in Israel, it was to Bethel that the people went up in their distress to ask counsel of God. (Judges 20:18,26,31; 21:2) Authorized Version, “house of God.” Here was the ark of the covenant. (Judges 20:26-28; 21:4) Later it is named as one of the holy cities to which Samuel went on circuit. (1 Samuel 7:16) Here Jeroboab placed one of the two calves of gold. Toward the end of Jeroboam’s life Bethel fell into the hands of Judah. (2 Chronicles 13:19) Elijah visited Bethel, and we hear of “sons of the prophets” as resident there. (2 Kings 2:2,3) But after the destruction of Baal worship by Jehu Bethel comes once more into view. (2 Kings 10:29) After the desolation of the northern kingdom by the king of Assyria, Bethel still remained an abode of priests. (2 Kings 17:27,28) In later times Bethel is named only once under the scarcely-altered name of Beitin . Its ruins still lie on the righthand side of the road from Jerusalem to Nablus. • A town in the south part of Judah, named in (Joshua 12:16) and 1Sam 30:27In (Joshua 15:30; 19:4; 1 Chronicles 4:29,30) the place appears under the name of Chesil, Bethuland Bethuel. Hiel the Bethelite is recorded as the rebuilder of Jericho. (1 Kings 16:34) • In (Joshua 16:1) and 1Sam 13:2Mount Bethel, a hilly section near Beth-el, is referred to.
entries.definition_ko: '하나님의 집'이라는 뜻으로 예루살렘 북쪽 약 12마일에 위치한 팔레스타인 중부의 유명한 도시이자 성지이다. 아브람이 가나안에 도착하기 전부터 이 이름이 존재했던 것으로 보이며(창세기 12:8), 야곱이 환상을 본 곳이자(창세기 28:11-19) 살았던 곳이다. 본래 이름은 루스였다(사사기 1:22). 사사 시대에 백성이 하나님께 여쭈러 올라간 곳이며 언약궤가 있었다(사사기 20:18). 사무엘이 순회한 성지 중 하나였고(사무엘상 7:16) 여로보암이 금송아지 하나를 세운 곳이기도 하다. 엘리야가 방문했고 선지자의 생도들이 거주했다(열왕기하 2:2). 앗수르 정복 후에도 제사장들의 거처로 남았다(열왕기하 17:27). 오늘날 베이틴이라는 이름으로 폐허가 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (house of the valley), a place on or near the border of Asher, on the north side of which was the ravine of Jiphthah-el (Joshua 19:27)
entries.definition_ko: '골짜기의 집'이라는 뜻으로 아셀 경계 근처, 입다엘 골짜기 북쪽에 위치한 장소이다(여호수아 19:27).

entries.definition: (depth), The mountains of. (Song of Solomon 2:17) There is no clue to guide us as to what mountains are intended here.
entries.definition_ko: '깊음'이라는 뜻으로 '베델의 산들'이 언급되나(아가 2:17) 어떤 산을 가리키는지 단서가 없다.

entries.definition: (house of mercy, or the flowing water), the Hebrew name of a reservoir or tank, with five “porches,” close upon the sheep-gate or “market” in Jerusalem. (John 5:2) The largest reservoir - Birket Israil - 360 feet long, 120 feet wide and 80 feet deep, within the walls of the city, close by St. Stephen’s Gate, and under the northeast wall of the Haram area, is generally considered to be the modern representative of Bethesda. Robinson, however, suggests that the ancient Bethesda is identical with what is now called the Pool of the Virgin, an intermittent pool, south of Birket Israil and north of the pool of Siloam.
entries.definition_ko: '자비의 집' 또는 '흐르는 물'이라는 뜻으로 예루살렘 양문(시장) 근처 다섯 개의 '행각'이 딸린 저수지 또는 못을 가리키는 히브리어 이름이다(요한복음 5:2). 성벽 안 스데반 문 근처의 가장 큰 저수지 비르켓 이스라일(길이 360피트, 너비 120피트, 깊이 80피트)이 오늘날 베데스다로 여겨지나, 로빈슨은 실로암 못 북쪽의 '동정녀의 샘'이 옛 베데스다일 가능성을 제기한다.

entries.definition: (neighbor’s house), a place named only in (Micah 1:11) From the context it was doubtless situated in the plain of Philistia.
entries.definition_ko: '이웃의 집'이라는 뜻으로 미가 1:11에만 나오며 문맥상 블레셋 평지에 위치했던 것으로 보인다.

entries.definition: (house of the wall), doubtless a place, though it occurs in the genealogies of Judah as if a person. (1 Chronicles 2:51)
entries.definition_ko: '벽의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다 족보에 인명처럼 등장하나 실제로는 지명으로 추정된다(역대상 2:51).

entries.definition: (camel-house), a town of Moab, in the downs east of Jordan. (Jeremiah 48:23) comp. Jere 48:21
entries.definition_ko: '낙타의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽 언덕 지대의 모압 성읍이다(예레미야 48:23).

entries.definition: Same as Gilgal. (Nehemiah 12:29)
entries.definition_ko: 길갈과 같은 곳이다(느헤미야 12:29).

entries.definition: (house of the vine). (Nehemiah 3:14; Jeremiah 6:1) A beacon station near Tekoa, supposed to be the Frank Mountain, a few miles southeast of Bethlehem.
entries.definition_ko: '포도나무의 집'이라는 뜻으로(느헤미야 3:14) 드고아 근처 봉화 초소였으며 베들레헴 남동쪽 몇 마일의 '프랑크산'으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (Numbers 32:36) It is no doubt the same place as BETH-ARAM. (Joshua 13:27)
entries.definition_ko: 벧아람(BETH-ARAM)과 같은 곳이다(민수기 32:36).

entries.definition: (partridge-house), and Holg’lah a place on the border of Judah, (Joshua 15:6) and of Benjamin. (Joshua 18:19,21) A magnificent spring and a ruin between Jericho and the Jordan still bear the names of Ainhajala.
entries.definition_ko: '자고새의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다(여호수아 15:6)와 베냐민(여호수아 18:19)의 경계에 위치한 곳이며 여리고와 요단강 사이의 웅장한 샘과 폐허가 오늘날에도 아인하잘라라는 이름으로 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (house of caverns), the name of two towns or villages, an “upper” and a “nether,” (Joshua 16:3,5; 1 Chronicles 7:24) on the road from Gibeon to Azekah, (Joshua 10:10,11) and the Philistine plain. 1 Macc. 3:24. Beth-horon lay on the boundary line between Benjamin and Ephraim, (Joshua 16:3,5) and Josh 18:13,14Was counted to Ephraim, (Joshua 21:22; 1 Chronicles 7:24) and given to the Kohathites. (Joshua 21:22; 1 Chronicles 6:68) (1Chr 6:53) The two Beth-horons still survive in the modern villages of Beit-ur, et-tahta and el-foka .
entries.definition_ko: '동굴들의 집'이라는 뜻으로 '위'와 '아래' 두 마을을 가리키며(여호수아 16:3) 기브온에서 아세가로 가는 길, 베냐민과 에브라임 경계에 위치했고 에브라임 지파와 고핫 자손에게 배정되었다. 오늘날 베이트우르 에타흐타와 엘포카로 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (house of deserts) or Jes’imoth, a town or place east of Jordan, on the lower level at the south end of the Jordan valley, (Numbers 33:49) and named with Ashdod-pisgah and Beth-peor. It was one of the limits of the encampment of Israel before crossing the Jordan. Later it was allotted to Reuben, (Joshua 12:3; 13:20) but came at last into the hands of Moab, and formed one of the cities which were “the glory of the country.” (Ezekiel 25:9)
entries.definition_ko: '광야들의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽, 요단 계곡 남쪽 끝 저지대의 성읍이며(민수기 33:49) 아스돗비스가, 벧브올과 함께 언급된다. 이스라엘이 요단강을 건너기 전 진영의 경계 중 하나였으며 이후 르우벤에게 배정되었으나(여호수아 12:3) 결국 모압의 소유가 되어 그 땅의 '영광'인 성읍 중 하나가 되었다(에스겔 25:9).

entries.definition: (house of lionesses), a town in the lot of Simeon, (Joshua 19:6) in the extreme south of Judah. [ (Joshua 15:32) Lebaoth] In (1 Chronicles 4:31) the name is given BETH-BIREI.
entries.definition_ko: '암사자들의 집'이라는 뜻으로 시므온 지파 몫의 성읍이며(여호수아 19:6) 유다 최남단에 위치한다. 역대상 4:31에서는 벧비레이라 불린다.

entries.definition: (house of bread). • One of the oldest towns in Palestine, already in existence at the time of Jacob’s return to the country. Its earliest name was Ephratah, Or Ephrathor EPHRATAH. See (Genesis 35:16,19; 48:7) After the conquest Bethlehem appears under its own name, BETHLEHEM-JUDAH. (Judges 17:7; 1 Samuel 17:12; Ruth 1:1,2) The book of Ruth is a page from the domestic history of Bethlehem. It was the home of Ruth, (Ruth 1:19) and of David. (1 Samuel 17:12) It was fortified by Rehoboam. (2 Chronicles 11:6) It was here that our Lord was born, (Matthew 2:1) and here that he was visited by the shepherds, (Luke 2:15-17) and the Magi. Matt 2. The modern town of Beitlahm lies to the east of the main road from Jerusalem to Hebron, six miles from the former. It covers the east and northeast parts of the ridge of a long gray hill of Jura limestone, which stands nearly due east and west, and is about a mile in length. The hill has a deep valley on the north and another on the south. On the top lies the village in a kind of irregular triangle. The population is about 3000 souls, entirely Christians. The Church of the Nativity, built by the empress Helena A.D. 330, is the oldest Christian church in existence. It is built over the grotto where Christ is supposed to have been born. • A town in the portion of Zebulun, named nowhere but in (Joshua 19:15) Now known as Beit-lahm .
entries.definition_ko: '빵의 집'이라는 뜻. (1) 팔레스타인에서 가장 오래된 도시 중 하나로 야곱이 가나안으로 돌아올 당시 이미 존재했으며 본래 이름은 에브랏이었다(창세기 35:16). 정복 이후에는 '유다 베들레헴'으로 불렸다(사사기 17:7). 룻기의 배경이며 룻과 다윗의 고향이었고 르호보암이 요새화했다(역대하 11:6). 주님이 이곳에서 태어나셨고(마태복음 2:1) 목자들과 동방박사들이 방문했다. 오늘날 베이틀라흠은 예루살렘-헤브론 대로 동쪽, 예루살렘에서 6마일 떨어져 있으며 인구 약 3000명 전원이 그리스도인이다. 헬레나 황후가 주후 330년에 세운 예수탄생교회는 현존하는 가장 오래된 그리스도교 교회 건물이다. (2) 스불론 지파 몫의 한 성읍으로 여호수아 19:15에만 언급된다.

entries.definition: 1 Esd. 5:17. [Bethlehem, 1]
entries.definition_ko: 베들레헴(BETHLEHEM) 1번 항목 참조(제1에스드라서 5:17).

entries.definition: (house of oppression), a place named only in (2 Samuel 20:14,15) In the absence of more information we can only conclude that it is identical with Maachah or Arammaachah, one of the petty Syrian kingdoms in the north of Palestine. (Comp. (2 Kings 15:29)
entries.definition_ko: '억압의 집'이라는 뜻으로 사무엘하 20:14,15에만 나오며 팔레스타인 북부의 작은 수리아 왕국 중 하나인 마아가 또는 아람마아가와 동일한 것으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (house of the chariots), one of the towns of Simeon, situated to the extreme south of Judah. (Joshua 19:5; 1 Chronicles 4:31) In the parallel list, (Joshua 15:31) Madmannah occurs in place of Beth-marcaboth.
entries.definition_ko: '병거들의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다 최남단 시므온 지파의 성읍이며(여호수아 19:5) 여호수아 15:31의 병행 목록에서는 맛만나로 나온다.

entries.definition: (Jeremiah 48:23) A contracted form of Beth-baal-meon.
entries.definition_ko: 벧바알므온의 축약형이다(예레미야 48:23).

entries.definition: (house of leopards) one of the fenced cities on the east of Jordan taken and built by the tribe of Gad (Numbers 32:36) and described as being in the valley beside Bethharan. (Joshua 13:27) In (Numbers 32:3) it is called simply Nimrah. The name still survives in the modern Nahr Nimrim, above Jericho on the Jordan.
entries.definition_ko: '표범들의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽 갓 지파가 세운 요새 성읍 중 하나이며(민수기 32:36) 벧하람 곁 골짜기에 있다고 묘사된다(여호수아 13:27). 민수기 32:3에서는 단순히 님라라 불린다.

entries.definition: (house of flight), a town among those in the extreme south of Judah, named in (Joshua 15:27)
entries.definition_ko: '도피의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다 최남단 성읍 중 하나이다(여호수아 15:27).

entries.definition: (house of the dispersion), a town of Issachar named with En-haddah (Joshua 19:21) and of which nothing is known.
entries.definition_ko: '흩어짐의 집'이라는 뜻으로 잇사갈 지파의 성읍이며 엔핫다와 함께 언급되나(여호수아 19:21) 그 외에는 알려진 바가 없다.

entries.definition: (house of Peor), a place on the east of Jordan, opposite Jericho and six miles above Libias or Beth-haran. (Joshua 13:20; 3:29; 4:46)
entries.definition_ko: '브올의 집'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽, 여리고 맞은편에서 6마일 위쪽에 위치한 곳이다.

entries.definition: (g hard) (house of figs) the name of a place on the Mount of Olives on the road between Jericho and Jerusalem. It was apparently close to Bethany. (Matthew 21:1; Mark 11:1; Luke 19:29)
entries.definition_ko: '무화과의 집'이라는 뜻으로 여리고에서 예루살렘으로 가는 길, 감람산 위의 한 장소이며 베다니와 가까웠던 것으로 보인다(마태복음 21:1).

entries.definition: (Nehemiah 11:26) [Bethpalet]
entries.definition_ko: 벧발렛(BETHPALET) 항목 참조(느헤미야 11:26).

entries.definition: a name which occurs in the genealogy of Judah as the son of Eshton. (1 Chronicles 4:12)
entries.definition_ko: 유다 족보에서 에스돈의 아들로 언급되는 이름이다(역대상 4:12).

entries.definition: (house of Rehob), place mentioned as having near it the valley in which lay the town of Laish or Dan. (Judges 18:28) It was one of the little kingdoms of Aram or Syria. (2 Samuel 10:6) Robinson conjectures that this ancient place is represented by the modern Hunin .
entries.definition_ko: '르홉의 집'이라는 뜻으로 라이스(단) 성읍이 있던 골짜기 근처에 위치했으며(사사기 18:28) 아람(수리아)의 작은 왕국 중 하나였다(사무엘하 10:6). 오늘날의 후닌으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (house of fish) of Galilee, (John 12:21) a city which was the native place of Andrew, Peter and Philip, (John 1:44; 12:21) in the land of Gennesareth, (Mark 6:46) comp. Mark 6:53And therefore on the west side of the lake. By comparing the narratives in (Mark 6:31-53) and Luke 9:10-17It appears certain that the Bethsaida at which the five thousand were fed must have been a second place of the same name on the east of the lake. (But in reality “there is but one Bethsaida, that known on our maps at Bethsaida Julias.” L. Abbot in Biblical and Oriental Journal . The fact is that Bethsaida was a village on both sides of the Jordan as it enters the sea of Galilee on the north, so that the western part of the village was in Galilee and the eastern portion in Gaulonitis, part of the tetrarchy of Philip. This eastern portion was built up into a beautiful city by Herod Philip, and named by him Bethsaida Julias, after Julia the daughter of the Roman emperor Tiberius Caesar. On the plain of Butaiha, a mile or two to the east, the five thousand were fed. The western part of the town remained a small village.—ED.)
entries.definition_ko: '물고기의 집'이라는 뜻으로 갈릴리의 도시이며(요한복음 12:21) 안드레, 베드로, 빌립의 고향이다. 갈릴리 호수 서쪽에 위치한 것으로 보이나, 오병이어 기적이 일어난 벳새다는 호수 동쪽의 동명이지로 추정된다. 헤롯 빌립이 동쪽 마을을 아름다운 도시로 확장해 로마 황제 티베리우스의 딸 율리아의 이름을 따 '벳새다 율리아스'라 불렀다.

entries.definition: (house of rest), or in Samuel, BETHSHAN, a city which belonged to Manasseh, (1 Chronicles 7:29) though within the limits of Issachar (Joshua 17:11) and therefore on the west of Jordan. Comp. 1 Macc. 5:62. In later times it was called Scythopolis. 2 Macc. 12:29. The place is still known as Beisan . It lies in the Ghor or Jordan valley, about twelve miles south of the Sea of Galilee and four miles west of the Jordan.
entries.definition_ko: '안식의 집'이라는 뜻으로 므낫세에 속했으나(역대상 7:29) 잇사갈 경계 안에 있어(여호수아 17:11) 요단강 서쪽에 위치한다. 후대에는 스구도볼리로 불렸으며 오늘날 베이산이라는 이름으로 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (house of the sun). • One of the towns which marked the north boundary of Judah. (Joshua 15:10) It is now ’Ainshems, about two miles from the great Philistine plain, and seven from Ekron. • A city on the border of Issachar. (Joshua 19:22) • One of the “fenced cities” of Naphtali. (Joshua 19:38; Judges 1:33) • An idolatrous temple, or place in Egypt. (Jeremiah 43:13) In the middle ages Heliopolis was still called by the Arabs Ain Shems .
entries.definition_ko: '태양의 집'이라는 뜻. (1) 유다 북쪽 경계의 성읍 중 하나(여호수아 15:10). (2) 잇사갈 경계의 도시(여호수아 19:22). (3) 납달리의 요새화된 성읍(여호수아 19:38). (4) 애굽의 우상 신전 또는 장소로(예레미야 43:13) 중세에도 아랍인들이 헬리오폴리스를 '아인 셈스'로 불렀다.

entries.definition: (home of the acacia), one of the spots to which the flight of the host of the Midianites extended after their discomfiture by Gideon. (Judges 7:22)
entries.definition_ko: '아카시아의 집'이라는 뜻으로 기드온에게 패한 미디안 무리가 도망친 장소 중 하나이다(사사기 7:22).

entries.definition: (house of apples), one of the towns of Judah in the mountainous district, and near Hebron. (Joshua 15:53) comp. 1Chr 2:43Here it has actually been discovered by Robinson under the modern name of Teffuh, five miles west of Hebron, on a ridge of high table-land.
entries.definition_ko: '사과의 집'이라는 뜻으로 헤브론 근처 유다 산악 지대의 성읍이며(여호수아 15:53) 로빈슨에 의해 헤브론 서쪽 5마일의 테푸흐라는 지명으로 실제 발견되었다.

entries.definition: (dweller in God), the son of Nahor by Milcah; nephew of Abraham, and father of Rebekah, (Genesis 22:22,23; 24:15,24,47; 28:2) In (Genesis 25:20) and (Genesis 28:5) he is called “Bethuel the Syrian.”
entries.definition_ko: '하나님 안에 거하는 자'라는 뜻으로 나홀이 밀가를 통해 낳은 아들이며 아브라함의 조카이자 리브가의 아버지이다(창세기 22:22,23). 창세기 25:20에서는 '아람 사람 브두엘'이라 불린다.

entries.definition: (dweller in God) a town of Simeon in the south named with Eltolad and Hormah, (Joshua 19:4) called also Chesil and Bethuel. (Joshua 15:30; 1 Chronicles 4:30)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님 안에 거하는 자'라는 뜻으로 남쪽 시므온 지파의 성읍이며 엘돌랏, 호르마와 함께 언급되고(여호수아 19:4) 그실 또는 브두엘이라고도 불린다(여호수아 15:30).

entries.definition: (house of rock) a town in the mountains of Judah, built by Jeroboam, (Joshua 15:58; 2 Chronicles 11:7) now Beit-zur . It commands the road from Beersheba and Hebron, which has always been the main approach to Jerusalem from the south.
entries.definition_ko: '바위의 집'이라는 뜻으로 유다 산악 지대의 성읍이며 르호보암이 건설했고(역대하 11:7) 오늘날 베이트수르이다. 브엘세바와 헤브론에서 예루살렘으로 오르는 남쪽 주요 접근로를 지배하는 위치에 있다.

entries.definition: a town of Gad, apparently on the northern boundary. (Joshua 13:26)
entries.definition_ko: 갓 지파의 북쪽 경계에 위치한 성읍이다(여호수아 13:26).

entries.definition: [Marriage.1]
entries.definition_ko: 결혼(MARRIAGE) 1번 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (married), the name which the land of Israel is to bear when “the land shall be married.” (Isaiah 62:4)
entries.definition_ko: '결혼한'이라는 뜻으로 이스라엘 땅이 '결혼하게 될' 때 지니게 될 이름이다(이사야 62:4).

entries.definition: (conqueror). “Children of Bezai,” to the number of 328, returned from captivity with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2:17; Nehemiah 7:23; 10:18)
entries.definition_ko: '정복자'라는 뜻으로 그 자손 328명이 스룹바벨과 함께 포로에서 돌아왔다(에스라 2:17).

entries.definition: (in the shadow of God). • The son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah and one of the architects of the tabernacle. (Exodus 31:1-6) His charge was chiefly in all works of metal, wood and stone. (B.C. 1490.) • One of the sons of Pahath-moab who had taken a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:30) (B.C. 458.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님의 그늘 안에'라는 뜻. (1) 유다 지파 훌의 손자이자 우리의 아들로 성막을 지은 장인 중 하나이며 금속·나무·돌 세공을 주로 맡았다(출애굽기 31:1-6). (2) 에스라 시대 이방 아내를 얻은 바핫모압 자손 중 하나(에스라 10:30).

entries.definition: (lightning). • The residence of Adonibezek, (Judges 1:6) in the lot of Judah. ver. (Judges 1:3) • Where Saul numbered the forces of Israel and Judah before going to the relief of Jabesh-gilead. (1 Samuel 11:8) This was doubtless somewhere in the centre of the country, near the Jordan valley. No identification of either place has been made in modern times.
entries.definition_ko: '번개'라는 뜻. (1) 아도니베섹의 거처로 유다 지파 몫에 있었다(사사기 1:6). (2) 사울이 야베스길르앗을 구하러 가기 전 이스라엘과 유다 군대를 소집한 곳(사무엘상 11:8)으로 나라 중앙, 요단 계곡 근처로 추정되나 확인되지 않았다.

entries.definition: (gold ore), son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher. (1 Chronicles 7:37)
entries.definition_ko: '금광석'이라는 뜻으로 아셀 지파 가문 우두머리 소바의 아들이다(역대상 7:37).

entries.definition: a city of refuge in the downs on the east of the Jordan. (4:43; Joshua 20:8; 21:36; 1 Chronicles 6:78)
entries.definition_ko: 요단강 동쪽 언덕 지대의 도피성이다(신명기 4:43).

entries.definition: The Bible is the name given to the revelation of God to man contained in sixty-six books or pamphlets, bound together and forming one book and only one, for it has in reality one author and one purpose and plan, and is the development of one scheme of the redemption of man. I. ITS Names.— (1) The Bible, i.e. The Book, from the Greek “ta biblia,” the books. The word is derived from a root designating the inner bark of the linden tree, on which the ancients wrote their books. It is the book as being superior to all other books. But the application of the word BIBLE to the collected books of the Old and New Testaments is not to be traced farther back than the fifth century of our era. (2) The Scriptures, i.e. the writings, as recording what was spoken by God. (3) The Oracles, i.e. the things spoken, because the Bible is what God spoke to man, and hence also called (4) The Word. (5) The Testaments or Covenants, because it is the testimony of God to man, the truths to which God bears witness; and is also the covenant or agreement of God with man for his salvation. (6) The Law, to express that it contains God’s commands to men. II. COMPOSITION.—The Bible consists of two great parts, called the Old and New Testaments, separated by an interval of nearly four hundred years. These Testaments are further divided into sixty-six books, thirty-nine in the Old Testament and twenty-seven in the New. These books are a library in themselves being written in every known form old literature. Twenty-two of them are historical, five are poetical, eighteen are prophetical, twenty-one are epistolary. They contain logical arguments, poetry, songs and hymns, history, biography, stories, parables, fables, eloquence, law, letters and philosophy. There are at least thirty-six different authors, who wrote in three continents, in many countries, in three languages, and from every possible human standpoint. Among these authors were kings, farmers, mechanics, scientific men, lawyers, generals, fishermen, ministers and priests, a taxcollector, a doctor, some rich, some poor, some city bred, some country born—thus touching all the experiences of men extending over 1500 years. III. UNITY.—And yet the Bible is but one book, because God was its real author, and therefore, though he added new revelations as men could receive them, he never had to change what was once revealed. The Bible is a unit, because (1) It has but one purpose, the salvation of men. (2) The character of God is the same. (3) The moral law is the same. (4) It contains the development of one great scheme of salvation. IV. ORIGINAL LANGUAGES.—The Old Testament was written in Hebrew, a Shemitic language, except that parts of the books of Ezra (Ezra 5:8; 6:12; 7:12-26) and of Daniel (Daniel 2:4-7,28) and one verse in Jeremiah (Jeremiah 10:11) were written in the Chaldee language. The New Testament is written wholly in Greek. V. ANCIENT MANUSCRIPTS OF THE ORIGINAL.—There are no ancient Hebrew manuscripts older than the tenth century, but we know that these are in the main correct, because we have a translation of the Hebrew into Greek, called the Septuagint, made nearly three hundred years before Christ. Our Hebrew Bibles are a reprint from what is called the Masoretic text. The ancient Hebrew had only the consonant printed, and the vowels were vocalized in pronunciation, but were not written. Some Jewish scholars living at Tiberias, and at Sora by the Euphrates, from the sixth to the twelfth century, punctuated the Hebrew text, and wrote is the vowel points and other tone-marks to aid in the reading of the Hebrew; and these, together with notes of various kinds, they called Masora (tradition), hence the name Masoretic text. 0F the Greek of the New Testament there are a number of ancient manuscripts They are divided into two kinds, the Uncials, written wholly in capitals, and the Cursives, written in a running hand . The chief of these are— (1) the Alexandrian (codex Alexandrinus, marked A), so named because it was found in Aiexandria in Egypt, in 1628. It date back to A.D. 350, and is now in the British Museum. (2) The Vatican (codex Vaticanus, B), named from the Vatican library at Rome, where it is kept. Its date is A.D. 300 to 325. (3) The Sinaitic (codex Sinaiticus) so called from the convent of St. Catherine on Mount Sinai, there it was discovered by or Tichendorf in 1844. It is now at St. Petersburg Russia. This is one of the earliest best of all the manuscripts. VI. TRANSLATIONS.—The Old Testament was translated into Greek by a company of learned Jews at Alexandria, who began their labor about the year B.C. 286. It is called the Septuagint, i.e. the seventy, from the tradition that it was translated by seventy (more exactly seventy-two) translators. The Vulgate, or translation of the Bible into Latin by Jerome, A.D. 385-405, is the authorized version of the Roman Catholic Church. The first English translation of the whole Bible was by John Deuteronomy Wickliffe (1324-1384). Then followed that of William Tyndale (1525) and several others. As the sum and fruit of all these appeared our present Authorized Version, or King James Version, in 1611. It was made by forty-seven learned men, in two years and nine months, with a second revision which took nine months longer. These fortyseven formed themselves into six companies, two of whom met at Westminster, two at Oxford and two at Cambridge. The present English edition is an improvement, in typographical and grammatical correctness, upon this revision, and in these respects is nearly perfect. [See Versions, Authorized] A REVISED VERSION of this authorized edition was made by a group of American and English scholars, and in 1881 the Revised New Testament was published simultaneously in the United States and England. Then followed the Revised Old Testament in 1885, and the Apocrypha in 1894. The American revision committee was permitted to publish its own revision, which appeared in 1901 as the American Standard Version. Modern-speech translations have been made from time to time between 1898-1945. Among these were Moulton’s Modern Reader’s Bible, the Twentieth century New Testament, Weymouth’s, Moffatt’s, and the American translation. As a result of the modern-speech translations that have appeared and been widely received, the American Revision Committee set to work again, and in 1946 the Revised Standard Version of the New Testament was published. VII. DIVISIONS INTO CHAPTERS AND VERSES.—The present division of the whole Bible into chapters was made by Cardinal Hugo Deuteronomy St. Gher about 1250. The present division into verses was introduced by Robert Stephens in his Greek Testament, published in 1551, in his edition of the Vulgate, in 1555. The first English Bible printed with these chapters and verses was the Geneva Bible, in 1560. VIII. CIRCULATION OF THE BIBLE.—The first book ever printed was the Bible; and more Bibles have been printed than any other book. It has been translated, in its entirety or in part, into more than a thousand languages and dialects and various systems for the blind. The American Bible Society (founded in 1816) alone has published over 356 million volumes of Scripture.
entries.definition_ko: 하나님이 인간에게 주신 계시를 담은 66권의 책을 하나로 묶은 것으로, 실제로는 한 저자와 하나의 목적·계획을 지닌 한 권의 책이며 인류 구속이라는 한 계획의 전개이다. '비블리아'(책들)라는 헬라어에서 유래했으며, 구약 39권 신약 27권으로 이루어져 있고 최소 36명 이상의 저자가 세 대륙, 여러 언어, 1500년에 걸쳐 기록했다. 구약은 대부분 히브리어로, 에스라와 다니엘 일부는 갈대아어로, 신약은 헬라어로 기록되었다. 주전 3세기경 칠십인역(헬라어 번역)이 만들어졌고, 히에로니무스의 라틴어 불가타(주후 385-405년)가 로마 가톨릭 공인역이 되었다. 영어 성경은 위클리프(1380년대), 틴들(1525년)을 거쳐 1611년 흠정역(킹제임스역)으로 완성되었으며, 이후 1881-1885년 개정역, 1901년 미국표준역, 1946년 개정표준역 신약이 나왔다. 장절 구분은 13세기 후고 추기경과 16세기 로버트 스티븐스에 의해 확립되었다.

entries.definition: (first-born), (2 Samuel 20:1) an ancestor of Sheba.
entries.definition_ko: '맏이'라는 뜻으로(사무엘하 20:1) 세바의 조상이다.

entries.definition: (son of stabbing, i.e, one who stabs), Jehu’s “captain,” originally his fellow officer, (2 Kings 9:25) who completed the sentence on Jehoram, son of Ahab.
entries.definition_ko: '찌르는 자의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 예후의 '지휘관'이자 본래 동료 장교였으며(열왕기하 9:25) 아합의 아들 여호람에 대한 심판을 집행했다.

entries.definition: [Burial, Sepulchres.1]
entries.definition_ko: 장례(BURIAL) 1번 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (gift of God), one of the seven chamberlains or eunuchs of the harem of King Ahasuerus. (Esther 1:10) (B.C. 483.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 주신'이라는 뜻으로 아하수에로 왕 후궁의 일곱 내시 중 하나이다(에스더 1:10).

entries.definition: (gift of God), a eunuch (chamberlain, Authorized Version) in the court of Ahasuerus, one of those “who kept the door,” and conspired with Teresh against the king’s life. (Esther 2:21) (B.C. 479.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 주신'이라는 뜻으로 아하수에로 궁정의 내시이며 문지기 중 하나로 데레스와 함께 왕을 암살하려다 발각되었다(에스더 2:21).

entries.definition: (happy). • “Children of Bigvai,” 2056 (Neh. 2067) in number, returned from the captivity with Zerubbabel, (Ezra 2:14; Nehemiah 7:19) and 72 of them at a later date with Ezra. (Ezra 8:14) (B.C. 536.) • Apparently one of the chiefs of Zerubbabel’s expedition, (Ezra 2:2; Nehemiah 7:7) whose family afterwards signed the covenant. (Nehemiah 10:16) (B.C. 410.)
entries.definition_ko: '행복한'이라는 뜻. (1) '비그왜의 자손' 2,056명이 스룹바벨과 함께 돌아왔고(에스라 2:14) 72명이 훗날 에스라와 함께 돌아왔다(에스라 8:14). (2) 스룹바벨 원정의 지도자 중 하나로 그 가문이 훗날 언약에 서명했다(느헤미야 10:16).

entries.definition: (son of contention), the second of Job’s three friends. He is called “the Shuhite,” which implies both his family and nation. (Job 2:11) (B.C. about 2000.)
entries.definition_ko: '다툼의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 욥의 세 친구 중 둘째이며 '수아 사람'이라 불려 그의 가문과 민족을 함께 나타낸다(욥기 2:11).

entries.definition: (foreigners), a town in the western half of the tribe of Manasseh, named only in (1 Chronicles 6:70) same as Ibleam and Gath-rimmon. (Joshua 17:11) and Josh 21:24
entries.definition_ko: '이방인들'이라는 뜻으로 므낫세 반 지파 서쪽 영토의 한 성읍이며 역대상 6:70에만 나오고 이블르암, 가드림몬과 같은 곳이다(여호수아 17:11).

entries.definition: (first-born). • A priest in the time of David; the head of the fifteenth course for the temple service. (1 Chronicles 24:14) (B.C. 1015.) • A priest or priestly family who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel and Jeshua. (Nehemiah 12:5,18) (B.C. 536.)
entries.definition_ko: '맏이'라는 뜻. (1) 다윗 시대 제사장으로 성전 봉사 열다섯째 반차의 우두머리(역대상 24:14). (2) 스룹바벨, 예수아와 함께 바벨론에서 돌아온 제사장 또는 제사장 가문(느헤미야 12:5).

entries.definition: (Nehemiah 10:8) [Bilgah, 2]
entries.definition_ko: 빌가(BILGAH) 2번 항목 참조(느헤미야 10:8).

entries.definition: (timid, bashful), handmaid of Rachel, (Genesis 29:29) and concubine of Jacob, to whom she bore Dan and Naphtali. (Genesis 30:3-8; 35:25; 46:25; 1 Chronicles 7:13) (B.C 53.)
entries.definition_ko: '수줍은, 소심한'이라는 뜻으로 라헬의 몸종이며(창세기 29:29) 야곱의 첩이 되어 단과 납달리를 낳았다(창세기 30:3-8).

entries.definition: (modest). • A Horite chief dwelling in Mount Seir. (Genesis 36:27; 1 Chronicles 1:42) • A Benjamite, son of Jediael. (1 Chronicles 7:10)
entries.definition_ko: '겸손한'이라는 뜻. (1) 세일산의 호리 족장(창세기 36:27). (2) 여디아엘의 아들인 베냐민 사람(역대상 7:10).

entries.definition: (eloquent), one of Zerubbabel’s companions on his expedition from Babylon. (Ezra 2:2; Nehemiah 7:7) (B.C. 536).
entries.definition_ko: '웅변적인'이라는 뜻으로 스룹바벨의 바벨론 귀환 원정 동료 중 하나이다(에스라 2:2).

entries.definition: (circumcised), one of the sons of Japhlet in the line of Asher. (1 Chronicles 7:33)
entries.definition_ko: '할례받은'이라는 뜻으로 아셀 계열 야블렛의 아들 중 하나이다(역대상 7:33).

entries.definition: (fountain), one of the descendants of Saul. (1 Chronicles 8:37; 7:43) (B.C. 850.)
entries.definition_ko: '샘'이라는 뜻으로 사울의 후손이다(역대상 8:37).

entries.definition: (familyship). • A Levite, father of Noadiah. (Ezra 8:33) • One who had taken a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:30) • Another Israelite who had also taken a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:38) • Altered from Baniin the corresponding list in Ezra. (Nehemiah 7:15) • A Levite, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah. (Nehemiah 3:24; 10:9)
entries.definition_ko: '가족 관계'라는 뜻. (1) 노아댜의 아버지인 레위인(에스라 8:33). (2)(3) 이방 아내를 얻은 인물들(에스라 10:30,38). (4) 병행 목록에서 바니로 바뀜(느헤미야 7:15). (5) 헤나닷의 아들로 느헤미야의 성벽 보수를 도운 레위인(느헤미야 3:24).

entries.definition: [Sparrow]
entries.definition_ko: 참새(SPARROW) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (son of godlessness), a king of Gomorrah. (Genesis 14:2)
entries.definition_ko: '경건치 않음의 아들'이라는 뜻으로 고모라 왕이다(창세기 14:2).

entries.definition: The custom of observing birthdays is very ancient, (Genesis 40:20; Jeremiah 20:15) and in (Job 1:4) etc., we read that Job’s sons “feasted every one his day.” In Persia birthdays were celebrated with peculiar honors and banquets, and in Egypt those of the king were kept with great pomp. It is very probable that in (Matthew 14:6) the feast to commemorate Herod’s accession is intended, for we know that such feasts were common, and were called “the day of the king.” (Hosea 7:5)
entries.definition_ko: 생일을 기념하는 관습은 매우 오래되었으며(창세기 40:20) 욥의 아들들도 '각각 자기 날에' 잔치를 벌였다(욥기 1:4). 바사와 애굽에서는 특히 왕의 생일이 성대하게 기념되었으며, 마태복음 14:6의 잔치도 헤롯의 즉위 기념일이었을 가능성이 있다.

entries.definition: the advantages accruing to the eldest son. These were not definitely fixed in patriarchal times. Great respect was paid to him in the household, and, as the family widened into a tribe, this grew into a sustained authority, undefined save by custom, in all matters of common interest. Thus the “princes” of the congregation had probably rights of primogeniture. (Numbers 7:2; 21:18; 25:14) (Gradually the rights of the eldest son came to be more definite: (1) The functions of the priesthood in the family with the paternal blessing. (2) A “double portion” of the paternal property was allotted by the Mosaic law. (21:16-17) (3) The eldest son succeeded to the official authority of the father. The first-born of the king was his successor by law. (2 Chronicles 21:3) In all these Jesus was the first-born of the father.
entries.definition_ko: 맏아들에게 주어지는 특권으로 족장 시대에는 명확히 규정되지 않았으나 집안에서 큰 존경을 받았다. 모세 율법 이후 점차 구체화되어 가정 내 제사장 직무와 아버지의 축복 계승, 아버지 재산의 '두 몫' 상속(신명기 21:16-17), 아버지의 공식적 권위 계승 등이 확립되었다.

entries.definition: a name occurring in the genealogies of Asher. (1 Chronicles 7:31)
entries.definition_ko: 아셀 족보에 나오는 이름이다(역대상 7:31).

entries.definition: The word originally signified an “overseer” or spiritual superintendent. The titles bishop and elder, or presbyter, were essentially equivalent. Bishop is from the Greek, and denotes one who exercises the function of overseeing. Presbyter was derived from the office in the synagogue. Of the order in which the first elders or bishops were appointed, as of the occasion which led to the institution of the office, we have no record. The duties of the bishop-elders appear to have been as follows: • General superintendence over the spiritual well-being of the flock. (1 Peter 5:2) • The work of teaching, both publicly and privately. (1 Thessalonians 5:12; Titus 1:9; 1 Timothy 5:17) • The work of visiting the sick, (James 5:14) • Among other acts of charity, that of receiving strangers occupied a conspicuous place. (1 Timothy 3:2; Titus 1:8) Peter calls Christ “the shepherd and bishop of your souls.” (1 Peter 2:25)
entries.definition_ko: 본래 '감독' 또는 영적 관리자를 뜻하며 '감독'과 '장로'는 본질적으로 같은 직분이었다. 감독-장로의 직무는 양떼의 영적 안녕에 대한 전반적 감독(베드로전서 5:2), 공적·사적 가르침(데살로니가전서 5:12), 병자 심방(야고보서 5:14), 나그네 영접(디모데전서 3:2) 등이었다. 베드로는 그리스도를 '너희 영혼의 목자와 감독'이라 부른다(베드로전서 2:25).

entries.definition: the district over which the jurisdiction of a bishop extended. (Acts 1:20; 1 Timothy 3:1)
entries.definition_ko: 감독의 관할 구역을 가리킨다(사도행전 1:20).

entries.definition: (daughter of the Lord), daughter of a Pharaoh, and wife of Mered. (1 Chronicles 4:18) (B.C. about 1491.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와의 딸'이라는 뜻으로 바로의 딸이며 므렛의 아내이다(역대상 4:18).

entries.definition: more accurately the Bithron (a craggy gorge or ravine), a place, doubtless a district, in the Jordan valley on the east side of the river. (2 Samuel 2:29)
entries.definition_ko: 정확히는 '비드론'(협곡 또는 골짜기)이라는 뜻으로 요단강 동쪽 계곡의 한 지역이다(사무엘하 2:29).

entries.definition: a Roman province of Asia Minor. Mentioned only in (Acts 16:7) and in 1Pet 1:1 The chief town of Bithynia was Nicaea, celebrated for the general Council of the Church held there in A.D. 325 against the Arian heresy.
entries.definition_ko: 소아시아의 로마 속주로 사도행전 16:7에만 언급된다. 주요 도시 니케아는 주후 325년 아리우스파 이단을 반박한 교회 공의회가 열린 곳으로 유명하다.

entries.definition: The Israelites were commanded to eat the Paschal lamb “with unleavened bread and with bitter herbs.” (Exodus 12:8) These “bitter herbs” consisted of such plants as chicory, bitter cresses, hawkweeds, sow-thistles and wild lettuces, which grow abundantly in the peninsula of Sinai, in Palestine and in Egypt. The purpose of this observance was to recall to the minds of the Israelites their deliverance from the bitter bondage of the Egyptians.
entries.definition_ko: 이스라엘 백성은 유월절 어린양을 '무교병과 쓴 나물과 함께' 먹으라는 명령을 받았다(출애굽기 12:8). 이 쓴 나물은 치커리, 쓴 냉이, 조밥나물, 방가지똥, 야생 상추 등으로 시내반도, 팔레스타인, 애굽에 흔했으며 애굽의 쓰라린 속박에서의 해방을 상기시키는 목적이었다.

entries.definition: The word occurs in (Isaiah 14:23; 34:11; Zephaniah 2:14) and we are inclined to believe that the Authorized Version is correct. The bittern (Botaurus stellaris) belongs to the Ardeidae, the heron family of birds, and is famous for the peculiar nocturnal booming sound which it emits.
entries.definition_ko: 이사야 14:23 등에 나오며 흠정역의 '알락해오라기' 번역이 옳은 것으로 보인다. 왜가리과에 속하며 밤에 울리는 독특한 울음소리로 유명하다.

entries.definition: (contempt of Jehovah), a town in the south of Judah. (Joshua 15:28)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와를 경멸함'이라는 뜻으로 유다 남쪽의 성읍이다(여호수아 15:28).

entries.definition: (eunuch), the second of the seven eunuchs of King Ahasuerus’ harem. (Esther 1:10) (B.C. 483.)
entries.definition_ko: '내시'라는 뜻으로 아하수에로 왕 후궁의 일곱 내시 중 둘째이다(에스더 1:10).

entries.definition: violent ulcerous inflammations, the sixth plague of Egypt, (Exodus 9:9,10) and hence called in (28:27,35) “the botch of Egypt.” It seems to have been the black leprosy, a fearful kind of elephantiasis.
entries.definition_ko: 심한 궤양성 염증으로 애굽의 여섯째 재앙이며(출애굽기 9:9) 검은 나병, 곧 무서운 형태의 코끼리피부병으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: in its technical English sense, signifies the speaking evil of God and in this sense it is found (Psalms 74:18; Isaiah 52:5; Romans 2:24) etc. But according to its derivation it may mean any species of calumny and abuse: see (1 Kings 21:10; Acts 18:6; Jude 1:9) etc. Blasphemy was punished by stoning, which was inflicted on the son of Shelomith. (Leviticus 24:11) On this charge both our Lord and St. Stephen were condemned to death by the Jews. The blasphemy against the Holy Ghost, (Matthew 12:32; Mark 3:28) consisted in attributing to the power of Satan those unquestionable miracles which Jesus performed by “the finger of God” and the power of the Holy Spirit. It is plainly such a state of wilful, determined opposition to God and the Holy Spirit that no efforts will avail to lead to repentance. Among the Jews it was a sin against God answering to treason in our times.
entries.definition_ko: 엄밀한 영어적 의미로는 하나님을 악하게 말하는 것을 뜻하나(시편 74:18) 어원상으로는 모든 종류의 비방과 모욕을 포함할 수 있다. 신성모독은 돌로 치는 형벌을 받았으며(레위기 24:11) 주님과 스데반 모두 이 죄목으로 유대인들에게 사형 선고를 받았다. 성령을 거스르는 신성모독(마태복음 12:32)은 예수님이 성령의 능력으로 행하신 명백한 기적을 사탄의 능력으로 돌리는 것을 가리키며, 회개로 이끌 수 없는 고의적이고 완강한 하나님·성령 대적 상태를 뜻한다.

entries.definition: (sprout), the chamberlain of Herod Agrippa I. (Acts 12:20)
entries.definition_ko: '싹'이라는 뜻으로 헤롯 아그립바 1세의 시종장이다(사도행전 12:20).

entries.definition: is extremely common in the East from many causes. Blind beggars figure repeatedly in the New Testament (Matthew 12:22) and “opening the eyes of the blind” is mentioned in prophecy as a peculiar attribute of the Messiah. (Isaiah 29:18; 42:7) etc. The Jews were specially charged to treat the blind with compassion and care. (Leviticus 19:14; 27:18) Blindness willfully inflicted for political or other purposes is alluded to in Scripture. (1 Samuel 11:2; Jeremiah 39:7)
entries.definition_ko: 동방에서는 여러 원인으로 매우 흔했다. 맹인 거지들이 신약에 자주 등장하며(마태복음 12:22) '맹인의 눈을 뜨게 함'은 메시아 고유의 표징으로 예언되었다(이사야 29:18). 유대인들은 맹인을 특별히 긍휼로 대하도록 명령받았다(레위기 19:14).

entries.definition: To blood is ascribed in Scripture the mysterious sacredness which belongs to life, and God reserved it to himself when allowing man the dominion over and the use of the lower animals for food. Thus reserved, it acquires a double power: (1) that of sacrificial atonement; and (2) that of becoming a curse when wantonly shed, unless duly expiated. (Genesis 9:4; Leviticus 7:26; 17:11-13)
entries.definition_ko: 성경에서 피는 생명에 속한 신비한 거룩함을 지닌 것으로 여겨지며, 하나님은 인간에게 짐승을 다스리고 먹을 권한을 주시면서도 피는 자신을 위해 남겨두셨다. 이로써 피는 속죄 제사의 능력과, 함부로 흘리면 반드시 갚아야 할 저주의 이중적 능력을 지닌다(창세기 9:4).

entries.definition: He who avenged the blood of one who had been killed. The nearest relative of the deceased became the authorized avenger of blood. (Numbers 35:19) The law of retaliation was not to extend beyond the immediate offender. (24:16; 2 Kings 14:6; 2 Chronicles 25:4; Jeremiah 31:29,30; Ezekiel 18:20)
entries.definition_ko: 살해된 자의 피를 갚는 자로, 가장 가까운 친족이 공인된 보복자가 되었다(민수기 35:19). 보복의 법은 직접적인 가해자를 넘어서지 않도록 제한되었다(신명기 24:16).

entries.definition: a name signifying sons of thunder, given by our Lord to the two sons of Zebedee, James and John, probably on account of their fiery earnestly. (Mark 3:17) See (Luke 9:54; Mark 9:38) comp. Matt 20:20etc.
entries.definition_ko: '우레의 아들들'이라는 뜻으로 주님이 세베대의 두 아들 야고보와 요한에게 붙이신 이름이며 그들의 열정적인 성격 때문으로 추정된다(마가복음 3:17).

entries.definition: [Swine]
entries.definition_ko: 돼지(SWINE) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (fleetness). • A wealthy Bethlehemite kinsman to Elimelech the husband of Naomi. He married Ruth, and redeemed the estates of her deceased husband Mahlon. (Ruth 4:1) Boaz is mentioned in the genealogy of Christ, (Matthew 1:5) (B.C. 1250, but there is great difficulty in assigning his date.) • The name of one of Solomon’s brazen pillars erected in the temple porch. [Jachin] It stood on the left, and was eighteen cubits high. (1 Kings 7:15; 21; 2 Chronicles 3:15; Jeremiah 52:21)
entries.definition_ko: '날쌤'이라는 뜻. (1) 베들레헴의 부유한 사람으로 나오미의 남편 엘리멜렉의 친족이며 룻과 결혼해 죽은 남편 말론의 기업을 무를 자가 되었다(룻기 4:1). 그리스도의 족보에 언급된다(마태복음 1:5). (2) 솔로몬이 성전 현관에 세운 두 놋기둥 중 왼쪽 기둥의 이름으로 높이 18규빗이었다(열왕기상 7:15).

entries.definition: (youth), son of Azel, according to the present Hebrew text of (1 Chronicles 8:38)
entries.definition_ko: '젊음'이라는 뜻으로 현재 히브리어 본문에 따르면 아셀의 아들이다(역대상 8:38).

entries.definition: (the weepers) a place on the west of Jordan, above Gilgal; so named from the weeping of Israel. (Judges 2:1,6)
entries.definition_ko: '우는 자들'이라는 뜻으로 요단강 서쪽, 길갈 위쪽의 한 장소이며 이스라엘의 울음에서 이름이 유래했다(사사기 2:1).

entries.definition: (thumb), a Reubenite. (Joshua 15:6; 18:17)
entries.definition_ko: '엄지손가락'이라는 뜻으로 르우벤 사람이다(여호수아 15:6).

entries.definition: a stone erected in honor of Bohan on the boundary between Judah and Benjamin, in the valley of Achor, along the eastern side of the present Wady Dahr, running into the Dead Sea.
entries.definition_ko: 유다와 베냐민 경계, 아골 골짜기에 보한을 기려 세운 돌이다(여호수아 15:6).

entries.definition: [Medicine]
entries.definition_ko: 의학(MEDICINE) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: [Slave]
entries.definition_ko: 종(SLAVE) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: [Writing]
entries.definition_ko: 기록(WRITING) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: [Succoth; Tabernacles, The Feast Of, FEAST OF]
entries.definition_ko: 초막절(TABERNACLES, THE FEAST OF) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: consisted of captives of both sexes, cattle, and whatever a captured city might contain, especially metallic treasures. Within the limits of Canaan no captives were to be made, (20:14,16) beyond these limits, in case of warlike resistance, all the women and children were to be made captives, and the men put to death. The law of booty is given in (Numbers 31:26-47) As regarded the army, David added a regulation that the baggage guard should share equally with the troops engaged. (1 Samuel 30:24; 25)
entries.definition_ko: 포로(남녀), 가축, 정복한 성읍의 모든 소유물, 특히 금속 보물로 구성되었다. 가나안 경내에서는 포로를 두지 못하게 했으나(신명기 20:14) 그 밖에서는 저항할 경우 여자와 아이는 포로로, 남자는 죽이도록 했다. 전리품 법은 민수기 31:26-47에 규정되어 있으며 다윗은 짐을 지킨 자도 전투에 참여한 자와 동등하게 나누도록 규정을 추가했다(사무엘상 30:24).

entries.definition: (Matthew 1:5; Luke 3:32) [Boaz]
entries.definition_ko: 보아스(BOAZ) 항목 참조(마태복음 1:5).

entries.definition: (2 Kings 22:1) [Bozkath]
entries.definition_ko: 복스갓(BOZKATH) 항목 참조(열왕기하 22:1).

entries.definition: same as Beor. (2 Peter 2:15)
entries.definition_ko: 브올(BEOR)의 신약 헬라어 표기이다(베드로후서 2:15).

entries.definition: The Arabs keep their water, milk and other liquids in leathern bottles. These are made of goatskins. When the animal is killed they cut off its feet and its head, and draw it in this manner out of the skin without opening its belly. The great leathern bottles are made of the skin of a he-goat, and the small ones, that serve instead of a bottle of water on the road, are made of a kid’s skin. The effect of external heat upon a skin bottle is indicated in (Psalms 119:83) “a bottle in the smoke,” and of expansion produced by fermentation in (Matthew 9:17) “new wine in old bottles.” Vessels of metal, earthen or glassware for liquids were in use among the Greeks, Egyptians, Etruscans and Assyrians, and also no doubt among the Jews, especially in later times. Thus (Jeremiah 19:1) “a potter’s earthen bottle.” (Bottles were made by the ancient Egyptians of alabaster, gold, ivory and stone. They were of most exquisite workmanship and elegant forms. Tear-bottles were small urns of glass or pottery, made to contain the tears of mourners at funerals, and placed in the sepulchres at Rome and in Palestine. In some ancient tombs they are found in great numbers. (Psalms 56:8) refers to this custom.—ED.)
entries.definition_ko: 아랍인들은 물, 우유 등을 가죽부대에 담아 보관했으며 염소 가죽으로 만들었다. 큰 부대는 숫염소 가죽으로, 작은 것은 새끼 염소 가죽으로 만들었다. 시편 119:83의 '연기 중의 가죽부대'는 외부 열의 영향을, 마태복음 9:17의 '새 포도주를 낡은 가죽부대에'는 발효로 인한 팽창을 나타낸다.

entries.definition: (Genesis 37:10) The eastern mode of salutation, by kneeling upon one knee and bending the head forward till it touched the ground.
entries.definition_ko: 창세기 37:10에 언급되는 동방식 인사법으로 한쪽 무릎을 꿇고 머리가 땅에 닿을 때까지 숙이는 것이다.

entries.definition: (Isaiah 41:19; 60:13) A beautiful evergreen growing in many parts of Europe and Asia. Its hard wood is much prized by engravers. The reference in (Isaiah 60:13) is supposed by some to mean a species of cedar.
entries.definition_ko: 이사야 41:19에 언급되는 아름다운 상록수로 유럽과 아시아 여러 지역에서 자라며 단단한 목재는 조각가들에게 귀히 여겨진다. 이사야 60:13의 언급은 일부 학자들에 의해 삼나무 일종을 가리키는 것으로 보기도 한다.

entries.definition: (the height), one of the two sharp rocks between the passages which Jonathan entered the Philistine garrison. It seems to have been that on the north. (1 Samuel 14:4,5)
entries.definition_ko: '높음'이라는 뜻으로 요나단이 블레셋 진지로 들어간 통로 사이 두 날카로운 바위 중 하나이며 북쪽에 위치한 것으로 보인다(사무엘상 14:4).

entries.definition: (rocky height), a city of Judah in the lowlands (Joshua 15:39; 2 Kings 22:1)
entries.definition_ko: '바위 높이'라는 뜻으로 저지대에 위치한 유다의 성읍이다(여호수아 15:39).

entries.definition: (fortress). • In Edom, the city of Jobab the son of Zerah, one of the early king of that nation. (Genesis 36:33; 1 Chronicles 1:44) Mentioned by Isaiah, (Isaiah 34:6; 63:1) in connection with Edom, and by Jeremiah, (Jeremiah 49:13,22; Amos 1:12) and (Micah 2:12) Its modern representative is el-Busaireh, which lies on the mountain district to the southeast of the Dead Sea. • In his catalogue of the cities of the land of Moab, Jeremiah, (Jeremiah 48:24) mentions a Bozrah as in “the plain country” (ver 21), i.e. the high level downs on the east of the Dead Sea.
entries.definition_ko: '요새'라는 뜻. (1) 에돔의 성읍으로 세라의 아들 요밥 왕의 거처였으며(창세기 36:33) 이사야, 예레미야, 아모스가 에돔과 관련해 언급한다. 오늘날의 엘부사이레로 사해 남동쪽 산악 지대에 위치한다. (2) 예레미야가 모압 성읍 목록에서 언급하는 또 다른 보스라로 사해 동쪽 평원 지대에 위치한다(예레미야 48:24).

entries.definition: [See Armlet] Bracelets of fine twisted Venetian gold are still common in Egypt. In (Genesis 38:18,25) the word rendered “bracelet” means probably a string by which a seal-ring was suspended. Men as well as women wore bracelets, as we see from (Song of Solomon 5:14) Layard says of the Assyrian kings, “The arms were encircled by armlets, and the wrists by bracelets.”
entries.definition_ko: 팔찌(ARMLET) 항목 참조. 창세기 38:18의 '팔찌'는 인장 반지를 매다는 끈을 가리키는 것으로 보이며, 남성도 여성처럼 팔찌를 착용했다(아가 5:14).

entries.definition: [Thorns]
entries.definition_ko: 가시나무(THORNS) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: The word nechosheth is improperly translated by “brass.” In most places of the Old Testament the correct translation would be copper, although it may sometimes possibly mean bronze a compound of copper and tin. Indeed a simple metal was obviously intended, as we see from (8:9; 33:25; Job 28) Copper was known at a very early period. (Genesis 4:22)
entries.definition_ko: 히브리어 '네호셋'은 '놋쇠'로 잘못 번역된 경우가 많으며 대부분 정확히는 '구리'를 가리키고 때로 청동(구리와 주석의 합금)을 뜻하기도 한다. 구리는 매우 이른 시기부터 알려졌다(창세기 4:22).

entries.definition: [Serpent]
entries.definition_ko: 뱀(SERPENT) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: The preparation of bread as an article of food dates from a very early period. (Genesis 18:6) The corn or grain employed was of various sorts. The best bread was made of wheat, but “barley” and spelt were also used. (John 6:9,13; Isaiah 28:25) The process of making bread was as follows: the flour was first mixed with water or milk; it was then kneaded with the hands (in Egypt with the feet also) in a small wooden bowl or “kneading-trough” until it became dough. (Exodus 12:34,39; 2 Samuel 13:3; Jeremiah 7:18) When the kneading was completed, leaven was generally added [Leaven]; but when the time for preparation was short, it was omitted, and unleavened cakes, hastily baked, were eaten as is still the prevalent custom among the Bedouins. ((Genesis 18:6; 19:3; Exodus 12:39; Judges 6:19; 1 Samuel 28:24) The leavened mass was allowed to stand for some time, (Matthew 13:33; Luke 13:21) the dough was then divided into round cakes, (Exodus 29:23; Judges 7:13; 8:5; 1 Samuel 10:3; Proverbs 6:26) not unlike flat stones in shape and appearance, (Matthew 7:9) comp. Matt 4:8About a span in diameter and a finger’s breadth in thickness.
