entries.definition: (God is with me). • A Benjamite, son of Jesaiah. (Nehemiah 11:7) • One of two persons—Ithiel and Ucal— to whom Agur ben-Jakeh delivered his discourse. (Proverbs 30:1) (B.C. about 900.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 나와 함께 계신다'는 뜻. (1) 여사야의 아들, 베냐민 사람(느헤미야 11:7). (2) 아굴 벤야게가 잠언을 전한 두 사람(이디엘과 우갈) 중 하나(잠언 30:1).

entries.definition: (bereavedness), a Moabite, one of the heroes of David’s guard. (1 Chronicles 11:46)
entries.definition_ko: '상실'이라는 뜻으로 모압 사람, 다윗의 근위 용사 중 하나이다(역대상 11:46).

entries.definition: (given), one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah. (Joshua 15:23) No trace of its existence has yet been discovered.
entries.definition_ko: '주어진'이라는 뜻으로 유다 최남단의 성읍 중 하나이다(여호수아 15:23). 아직 확인되지 않았다.

entries.definition: (excellence), an Israelite, (2 Samuel 17:25) or Ishmaelite, (1 Chronicles 2:17) the father of Amasa by Abigail, David’s sister. (B.C. before 1023.)
entries.definition_ko: '탁월함'이라는 뜻으로 다윗의 누이 아비가일을 통해 아마사를 낳은 이스라엘 사람(또는 이스마엘 사람)이다(사무엘하 17:25).

entries.definition: (excellence). • A son of Dishon, a Horite, (Genesis 36:26; 1 Chronicles 1:41) and probably a phylarch of a tribe of the Horim. (Genesis 36:30) (B.C. about 1800.) • A descendant of Asher. (1 Chronicles 7:30-40)
entries.definition_ko: '탁월함'이라는 뜻. (1) 호리 사람 디손의 아들로 호리 족속의 족장으로 추정(창세기 36:26). (2) 아셀의 후손(역대상 7:30).

entries.definition: (abundance of people), son of David, born to him in Hebron, and distinctly specified as the sixth, and as the child of Eglah, David’s wife. (2 Samuel 3:5; 1 Chronicles 3:3)
entries.definition_ko: '백성의 풍성함'이라는 뜻으로 다윗이 헤브론에서 아내 에글라를 통해 낳은 여섯째 아들이다(사무엘하 3:5).

entries.definition: (belonging to Jether), The, the designation of two of the members of David’s guard, Ira and Gareb. (2 Samuel 23:38; 1 Chronicles 11:40) They may have come from Jattir, in the mountains of Judah. (B.C 1046.)
entries.definition_ko: '예델에 속한'이라는 뜻으로 다윗의 근위 용사 이라와 가렙 두 사람에게 붙은 명칭이다(사무엘하 23:38). 유다 산지의 얏딜 출신이었을 것으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (time of the judge), one of the landmarks of the boundary of Zebulun. (Joshua 19:13) It has not been identified.
entries.definition_ko: '재판관의 때'라는 뜻으로 스불론 경계의 지표 중 하나이다(여호수아 19:13). 확인되지 않았다.

entries.definition: (with the Lord). • “Ittai the Gittite,” i.e. the native of Gath, a Philistine in the army of King David. He appears only during the revolution of Absalom. (B.C. 1023.) We first discern him on the morning of David’s flight. The king urges him to return. (2 Samuel 15:18,19) Comp. 1Sam 23:13; 27:2; 30:9,10,19,20But ittai is firm; he is the king’s slave, and wherever his master goes he will go. Accordingly he is allowed by David to proceed. When the army was numbered and organized by David at Mahanaim, Ittai again appears, now in command of a third part of the force. (2 Samuel 18:2,5,12) • Son of Ribai, from Gibeah of Benjamin; one of the thirty heroes of David’s guard. (2 Samuel 23:29)
entries.definition_ko: '주와 함께'라는 뜻. (1) '가드 사람 잇대', 다윗 군대의 블레셋 사람으로 압살롬의 반역 때만 등장한다. 다윗이 도피하던 아침 왕이 돌아가라 권했으나 잇대는 왕의 종으로서 왕이 가는 곳이면 어디든 가겠다며 거절해 함께하도록 허락받았다(사무엘하 15:18). 마하나임에서 군대를 조직할 때 삼분의 일을 지휘했다(사무엘하 18:2). (2) 베냐민 기브아 사람 리배의 아들, 다윗의 삼십 용사 중 하나(사무엘하 23:29).

entries.definition: (land of Jether), a small province on the northwestern border of Palestine, lying along the base of Mount Hermon, only mentioned in (Luke 3:1) Jetur the son of Ishmael gave his name like the rest of his brethren, to the little province he colonized. (Genesis 25:15,16) It adjoined Trachonitis, and lay along the base of Libanus between Tiberias and Damascus. At the place indicated is situated the modern province of Jedur, which is the Arabic form of the Hebrew Jetur
entries.definition_ko: '예델의 땅'이라는 뜻으로 헤르몬산 기슭을 따라 있는 팔레스타인 북서쪽 경계의 작은 지방이며 누가복음 3:1에만 언급된다. 이스마엘의 아들 여둘이 이 지역에 정착해 이름을 남겼다(창세기 25:15). 드라고닛에 인접했으며 디베랴와 다메섹 사이 레바논 산기슭을 따라 위치했고 오늘날 아랍어 지명 제두르로 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (ruined), or A’va, which is mentioned in Scripture twice, (2 Kings 18:34; 19:13) comp. Isai 37:13In connection with Hena and Sepharvaim, and once, (2 Kings 17:24) in connection with Babylon and Cuthah, must be sought in Babylonia, and is probably identical with the modern Hit, on the Euphrates.
entries.definition_ko: '폐허가 된'이라는 뜻으로 성경에 두 번(열왕기하 18:34) 헤나·스발와임과 함께, 한 번(열왕기하 17:24) 바벨론·굿과 함께 언급되며 바벨로니아 지역, 오늘날 유브라데강변의 히트와 동일시된다.

entries.definition: The word translated “ivory” literally signifies the “tooth” of any animal, and hence more especially denotes the substance of the projecting tusks of elephants. The skilled work-men of Hiram, king of Tyre, fashioned the great ivory throne of Solomon, and overlaid it with pure gold. (1 Kings 10:18; 2 Chronicles 9:17) The ivory thus employed was supplied by the caravans of Dedan, (Isaiah 21:13; Ezekiel 27:15) or was brought, with apes and peacocks, by the navy of Tarshish. (1 Kings 10:22) The “ivory house” of Ahab, (1 Kings 22:39) was probably a palace, the walls of which were panelled with ivory, like the palace of Menelaus described by Homer. Odys. iv. 73. Beds inlaid or veneered with ivory were in use among the Hebrews. (Amos 6:4)
entries.definition_ko: '상아'로 번역된 단어는 문자적으로 동물의 '이빨'을 뜻하며 특히 코끼리의 어금니를 가리킨다. 두로 왕 히람의 숙련된 기술자들이 솔로몬의 상아 보좌를 만들어 순금을 입혔다(열왕기상 10:18). 이 상아는 드단의 대상을 통해 공급되거나(이사야 21:13) 다시스의 배들이 원숭이·공작과 함께 실어왔다(열왕기상 10:22). 아합의 '상아궁'(열왕기상 22:39)은 벽이 상아로 장식된 궁전이었을 것이며 상아를 상감한 침상도 히브리인들 사이에서 쓰였다(아모스 6:4).

entries.definition: (oil), the form in which the name Izhar is given in the Authorized Version of (Numbers 3:19) only.
entries.definition_ko: '기름'이라는 뜻으로 민수기 3:19에서만 이스할이 이 형태로 표기된다.

entries.definition: (descendant of Izhar), The. A family of Kohathite Levites, descended from Izhar the son of Kohath, (Numbers 3:27) called also “Izharites” (1 Chronicles 26:23,29)
entries.definition_ko: 고핫의 아들 이스할의 후손인 고핫 가문 레위인들이며(민수기 3:27) '이스할 자손'이라고도 불린다(역대상 26:23).

entries.definition: (oil), son of Kohath grandson of Levi, uncle of Aaron and Moses and father of Korah. (Exodus 6:18,21; Numbers 3:19; 16:1; 1 Chronicles 6:2,18) (B.C. after 1490.) Izhar was the head of the family of the Izharites, (1 Chronicles 24:22; 26:23) or Izeharites. (Numbers 3:27; 1 Chronicles 26:23,29)
entries.definition_ko: '기름'이라는 뜻으로 고핫의 아들, 레위의 손자, 아론과 모세의 삼촌이며 고라의 아버지이다(출애굽기 6:18). 이스할 자손 가문의 시조였다(역대상 24:22).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah causes to sparkle), a chieftain of Issachar. (1 Chronicles 7:3)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 빛나게 하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 잇사갈의 지도자이다(역대상 7:3).

entries.definition: (descendant of Zerah), The, the designation of Shamhuth (1 Chronicles 27:8) Its real force probably Zerahite, that is, from the great Judaic family of Zerah.
entries.definition_ko: '세라의 후손'이라는 뜻으로 삼훗에게 붙은 명칭이며(역대상 27:8) 실제로는 '세라 사람', 곧 유다의 큰 가문 세라 출신을 뜻하는 것으로 보인다.

entries.definition: (creator), a Levite leader of the fourth course or ward in the service of the house of God. (1 Chronicles 25:11) In ver. 3 he is called Zeri. (B.C. 1014.)
entries.definition_ko: '창조자'라는 뜻으로 성전 봉사 넷째 반차의 레위인 지휘자이다(역대상 25:11). 3절에서는 세리로 불린다.

entries.definition: (he shall surround), the same as Jakan, the forefather of Bene-Jaakan. (10:6)
entries.definition_ko: '그가 둘러싸리라'는 뜻으로 야간과 동일 인물, 브네야간의 조상이다(신명기 10:6).

entries.definition: (supplanter), one of the princes of the families of Simeon. (1 Chronicles 4:36) (B.C. about 710.)
entries.definition_ko: '발뒤꿈치를 잡는 자'라는 뜻으로 시므온 가문 지도자 중 하나이다(역대상 4:36).

entries.definition: (wild she-goat). Bene-Jaala were among the descendants of “Solomon’s slaves” who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel. (Nehemiah 7:58) (B.C. before 536.) The name also occurs as Ja-alah.
entries.definition_ko: '들염소'라는 뜻으로 브네야알라는 스룹바벨과 함께 바벨론에서 돌아온 '솔로몬의 종들'의 자손 중 하나였다(느헤미야 7:58). 야알라라는 표기로도 나온다.

entries.definition: (wild goat). (Ezra 2:56)
entries.definition_ko: 야알라(JAALA) 항목 참조(에스라 2:56).

entries.definition: (whom God hides), a son of Esau, (Genesis 36:5,14,18) comp. 1Chr 1:35And a head of a tribe of Edom. (B.C. 1790.).
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 숨기시는 자'라는 뜻으로 에서의 아들이며(창세기 36:5) 에돔의 한 지파 우두머리이다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah answers), a chief man in the tribe of Gad. (1 Chronicles 5:12)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 응답하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 갓 지파의 지도자였다(역대상 5:12).

entries.definition: (forests of the weavers), (2 Samuel 21:19) a Bethlehemite, and the father of Elhanan who slew Goliath. In the parallel passage, (1 Chronicles 20:5) Jair is found instead of Jaare, and Oregim is omitted. (B.C. 1063.)
entries.definition_ko: '직조공들의 숲'이라는 뜻으로(사무엘하 21:19) 베들레헴 사람, 골리앗을 죽인 엘하난의 아버지이다. 병행 기사(역대상 20:5)에서는 야레 대신 야일로 나오고 오레김은 생략된다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah made), one of the Bene-Bani who had married a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:37) (B.C. 459.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 만드신 자'라는 뜻으로 이방인 아내와 결혼한 브네바니 가문 중 하나이다(에스라 10:37).

entries.definition: (whom God comforts), son of the great Abner. (1 Chronicles 27:21) (B.C. 10461014.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 위로하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 위대한 아브넬의 아들이다(역대상 27:21).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah hears). • One of the captains of the forces who accompanied Hohanan ben-Kareah to pay his respects to Gedaliah at Mizpah, (2 Kings 25:23) and who appears afterwards to have assisted in recovering Ishmael’s prey from his clutches. Comp. (Jeremiah 41:11; 43:4,5) (B.C. 587.) • Son of Shaphan. (Ezekiel 8:11) It is possible that he is identical with • Son of Azur; one of the princes of the people against whom Ezekiel was directed to prophesy. (Ezekiel 11:1) (B.C. 593.) • A Rechabite, son of Jeremiah. (Jeremiah 35:3) (B.C. 606.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 들으시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 그다랴에게 경의를 표하러 미스바에 간 요하난 벤가레아와 함께한 부대장 중 하나(열왕기하 25:23). (2) 사반의 아들(에스겔 8:11). (3) 아술의 아들, 에스겔이 예언하도록 지시받은 백성의 지도자 중 하나(에스겔 11:1). (4) 레갑 사람, 예레미야의 아들(예레미야 35:3).

entries.definition: (Jehovah helps), a town on the east of Jordan, in or near to Gilead. (Numbers 32:1,3; 1 Chronicles 26:31) We first hear of it in possession of the Amorites, and as taken by Israel after Heshbon, and on their way from thence to Bashan. (Numbers 21:32) It seems to have given its name to a district of dependent or “daughter” towns, (Numbers 21:32) Authorized Version “villages,” 1 Macc. 5:8, the “land of Jazer.” (Numbers 32:1)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 도우신다'는 뜻으로 요단 동편 길르앗 근처의 성읍이다(민수기 32:1). 처음에는 아모리 족속 소유였으나 헤스본 정복 후 이스라엘이 바산으로 가는 길에 함락시켰다(민수기 21:32). 인근 종속 성읍들('야셀 땅')을 거느린 것으로 보인다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah comforts), apparently a third son, or a descendant, or Merari the Levite. (1 Chronicles 24:26,27) (B.C. before 1014).
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 위로하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 레위인 므라리의 셋째 아들 또는 후손으로 보인다(역대상 24:26).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah comforts), one of the Levites appointed by David to perform the musical service before the ark. (1 Chronicles 15:18) (B.C. 1014).
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 위로하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 다윗이 언약궤 앞 음악 봉사를 위해 임명한 레위인 중 하나이다(역대상 15:18).

entries.definition: (stream), the son of Lamech and Adah, (Genesis 4:20) and brother of Jubal. He is described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle.
entries.definition_ko: '시내'라는 뜻으로 라멕과 아다의 아들이며(창세기 4:20) 유발의 형제이다. 장막에 거하며 가축을 치는 자들의 조상으로 묘사된다.

entries.definition: (emptying), a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, comp. (Joshua 12:2,5) and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea. It was anciently the border of the children of Ammon. (Numbers 21:24; 2:37; 3:16) It was on the south bank of the Jabbok that the interview took place between Jacob and Esau, (Genesis 32:22) and this river afterward became, toward its western part, the boundary between the kingdoms of Sihon and Og. (Joshua 12:2,5) Its modern name is Wady Zurka .
entries.definition_ko: '비움'이라는 뜻으로 길르앗 산맥을 가로질러 갈릴리 호수와 사해 사이 중간 지점에서 동쪽으로 요단강에 합류하는 시내이다. 고대에는 암몬 자손의 경계였다(민수기 21:24). 얍복강 남쪽 강변에서 야곱과 에서의 만남이 있었고(창세기 32:22) 이후 서쪽 부분은 시혼과 옥 왕국의 경계가 되었다. 오늘날 이름은 와디 주르카이다.

entries.definition: (dry). • Father of Shallum, the fifteenth king of Israel. (2 Kings 15:10,13,14) • Jabesh-gilead, or Jabesh in the territory of Gilead. In its widest sense Gilead included the half tribe of Manasseh, (1 Chronicles 27:21) as well as the tribes of Gad and Reuben, (Numbers 32:1-42) east of the Jordan; and of the cities of Gilead, Jabesh was the chief. It is first mentioned in (Judges 21:8-14) Being attacked subsequently by Nahash the Ammonite, it gave Saul an opportunity of displaying his prowess in its defence. (1 Samuel 11:1-15) Eusebius places it beyond the Jordan, six miles from Pella on the mountain road to Gerasa; where its name is probably preserved in the Wady Yabes.
entries.definition_ko: '마른'이라는 뜻. (1) 이스라엘 열다섯째 왕 살룸의 아버지(열왕기하 15:10). (2) 야베스길르앗, 길르앗 영토 안의 성읍 중 으뜸. 사사기 21:8에 처음 언급되며 암몬 사람 나하스에게 공격당하자 사울이 이를 구원해 명성을 얻었다(사무엘상 11:1). 유세비우스는 요단강 건너, 펠라에서 게라사로 가는 산길 6마일 지점으로 추정하며 오늘날 와디야베스에 그 이름이 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (sorrow). • Apparently a place at which the families of the scribes resided who belonged to the families of the Kenites. (1 Chronicles 2:55) • The name occurs again in the genealogies of Judah, (1 Chronicles 4:9,10) in a passage of remarkable detail inserted in a genealogy again connected with Bethlehem. ver. 4.
entries.definition_ko: '슬픔'이라는 뜻. (1) 겐 족속 서기관 가문이 거주한 곳으로 보이는 장소(역대상 2:55). (2) 유다 족보, 베들레헴과 연관된 구절에 상세히 묘사된 인물(역대상 4:9).

entries.definition: (whom God observes). • King of Hazor, who organized a confederacy of the northern princes against the Israelites. (Joshua 11:1-3) Joshua surprised the allied forces by the waters of Merom, ver. 7, and utterly routed them. (B.C. 1448.) During the ensuing wars Joshua again attacked Jabin, and burnt his city. (Joshua 11:1-14) • A king of Hazor, whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak. (Judges 4:2,13) (B.C. 1316.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 살피시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 하솔 왕으로 이스라엘에 맞서 북방 왕들의 동맹을 조직했으나(여호수아 11:1) 여호수아에게 므롬 물가에서 완패당하고 성읍이 불탔다. (2) 하솔 왕, 그 장군 시스라가 바락에게 패배당함(사사기 4:2).

entries.definition: (building of God). • One of the points on the northern boundary of Judah, not quite at the sea, though near it. (Joshua 15:11) There is no sign, however, of its ever having been occupied by Judah. Josephus attributes it to the Danites. There was a constant struggle going on between that tribe and the Philistines for the possession of all the places in the lowland plains, and it is not surprising that the next time we meet with Jabneel it should be in the hands of the latter. (2 Chronicles 26:6) Uzziah dispossessed them of it and demolished its fortifications. Called also Jabneh. At the time of the fall of Jerusalem, Jabneh was one of the most populous places of Judea. The modern village of Yebna, more accurately Ibna, stands about two miles from the sea, on a slight eminence just south of the Nahr Rubin . • One of the landmarks on the boundary of Naphtali, (Joshua 19:33) in upper Galilee.
entries.definition_ko: '하나님의 건축'이라는 뜻. (1) 유다 북쪽 경계 지표 중 하나로 바닷가에 가깝다(여호수아 15:11). 요세푸스는 이를 단 지파 소유로 본다. 훗날 블레셋 사람 손에 들어갔으나 웃시야가 되찾아 요새를 헐었다(역대하 26:6). '얍네'라고도 불리며 예루살렘 함락 당시 유대에서 가장 인구가 많은 곳 중 하나였다. 오늘날 마을 예브나(이브나)가 그 자리에 남아 있다. (2) 상부 갈릴리 납달리 경계 지표 중 하나(여호수아 19:33).

entries.definition: (building of God), (2 Chronicles 26:6) [Jabneel]
entries.definition_ko: '하나님의 건축'(역대하 26:6). 얍느엘(JABNEEL) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (affliction), one of seven chief men of the tribe of Gad. (1 Chronicles 5:13)
entries.definition_ko: '고난'이라는 뜻으로 갓 지파 일곱 지도자 중 하나이다(역대상 5:13).

entries.definition: (he shall establish). • One of the two pillars which were set up “in the porch,” (1 Kings 7:21) or before the temple. (2 Chronicles 3:17) of Solomon. [Boaz] • Fourth son of Simeon, (Genesis 46:10; Exodus 6:15) founder of the family of the Jachinites. (Numbers 26:12) • Head of the twenty-first course of priests in the time of David. (1 Chronicles 9:10; 24:17; Nehemiah 11:10)
entries.definition_ko: '그가 세우시리라'는 뜻. (1) 솔로몬 성전 현관 앞에 세워진 두 기둥 중 하나(열왕기상 7:21, 다른 하나는 보아스). (2) 시므온의 넷째 아들, 야긴 자손의 조상(창세기 46:10). (3) 다윗 시대 제사장 스물한째 반차의 우두머리(역대상 9:10).

entries.definition: a precious stone, forming one of the foundations of the walls of the new Jerusalem. (Revelation 21:20) Called hyacinth in the Revised Version. This is simply a different English rendering of the same Greek original. It is probably identical with the lighure of (Exodus 28:19) The Jacinth or hyacinth is a red variety of zircon, which is found in square prisms of a white, gray, red, reddish-brown, yellow or pale-green color. The expression in (Revelation 9:17) “of jacinth,” is descriptive simply of a dark-purple color.
entries.definition_ko: 새 예루살렘 성벽 기초석 중 하나인 보석이다(계시록 21:20). 개정역에서는 '히아신스'로 불리며 같은 헬라어 원어의 다른 영어 표기일 뿐이다. 출애굽기 28:19의 '리굴'과 동일한 것으로 추정된다. 자킨트(히아신스)는 붉은 계열의 지르콘으로 흰색·회색·붉은색·갈색·노란색·연두색 등 다양한 색의 사각기둥 결정으로 발견된다.

entries.definition: (supplanter), the second son of Isaac and Rebekah. He was born with Esau, probably at the well of Lahai-roi, about B.C. 1837. His history is related in the latter half of the book of Genesis. He bought the birthright from his brother Esau, and afterward acquired the blessing intended for Esau, by practicing a well-known deceit on Isaac. (Jacob did not obtain the blessing because of his deceit, but in spite of it. That which was promised he would have received in some good way; but Jacob and his mother, distrusting God’s promise, sought the promised blessing in a wrong way, and received with it trouble and sorrow.—ED.) Jacob, in his 78th year, was sent from the family home to avoid his brother, and to seek a wife among his kindred in Padan-aram. As he passed through Bethel, God appeared to him. After the lapse of twenty-one years he returned from Padan-aram with two wives, two concubines, eleven sons and a daughter, and large property. He escaped from the angry pursuit of Laban, from a meeting with Esau, and from the vengeance of the Canaanites provoked by the murder of Shechem; and in each of these three emergencies he was aided and strengthened by the interposition of God, and in sign of the grace won by a night of wrestling with God his name was changed at Jabbok into Israel. Deborah and Rachel died before he reached Hebron; Joseph, the favorite son of Jacob, was sold into Egypt eleven years before the death of Isaac; and Jacob had probably exceeded his 130th year when he went tither. He was presented to Pharaoh, and dwelt for seventeen years in Rameses and Goshen, and died in his 147th year. His body was embalmed, carried with great care and pomp into the land of Canaan, and deposited with his fathers, and his wife Leah, in the cave of Machpelah. The example of Jacob is quoted by the first and the last of the minor prophets. Besides the frequent mention of his name in conjunction with the names of the other two patriarchs, there are distinct references to the events in the life of Jacob in four books of the New Testament - (John 1:51; 4:5,12; Acts 7:12,16; Romans 9:11-13; Hebrews 11:21; 12:16)
entries.definition_ko: '발뒤꿈치를 잡는 자'라는 뜻으로 이삭과 리브가의 둘째 아들이며 에서와 쌍둥이로 태어났다(주전 1837년경). 에서에게서 장자권을 사고 이삭을 속여 축복을 가로챘다. 78세에 형을 피해 밧단아람으로 아내를 구하러 떠났고 벧엘에서 하나님이 나타나셨다. 21년 후 두 아내, 두 첩, 열한 아들과 딸 하나, 많은 재산을 이끌고 돌아왔다. 라반의 추격, 에서와의 만남, 세겜 사건으로 인한 가나안 족속의 보복 위기 등 세 번의 위기에서 하나님의 도우심을 받았고 얍복강에서 밤새 씨름한 표징으로 이름이 이스라엘로 바뀌었다. 드보라와 라헬은 헤브론 도착 전에 죽었고 요셉은 이삭이 죽기 11년 전 애굽에 팔려갔다. 147세에 죽었으며 시신은 방부 처리되어 성대히 가나안으로 옮겨져 막벨라 굴, 아내 레아와 함께 묻혔다.

entries.definition: a deep spring in the vicinity of Shechem (called Sychar in Christ’s time and Nablus at the present day). It was probably dug by Jacob whose name it bears. On the curb of the well Jesus sat and discoursed with the Samaritan woman. (John 4:5-26) It is situated about half a mile southeast of Nablus, at the foot of Mount Gerizim. It is about nine feet in diameter and 75 feet deep. At some seasons it is dry; at others it contains a few feet of water.
entries.definition_ko: 세겜(그리스도 시대에는 수가, 오늘날 나블루스) 근처의 깊은 샘으로 야곱이 판 것으로 추정되어 그의 이름을 지녔다. 예수님이 우물 턱에 앉아 사마리아 여인과 대화하신 곳이다(요한복음 4:5). 나블루스에서 남동쪽으로 약 반 마일, 그리심산 기슭에 위치하며 지름 약 9피트, 깊이 75피트이다.

entries.definition: (wise), son of Onam and brother of Shammai, in the genealogy of the sons of Jerahmeel by his wife Atarah. (1 Chronicles 2:28,32) (B.C. after 1445.)
entries.definition_ko: '지혜로운'이라는 뜻으로 오남의 아들이자 삼매의 형제, 여라므엘 족보에 속한다(역대상 2:28).

entries.definition: (loving), one of the Bene-Nebo who had taken a foreign wife. (Ezra 10:43) (B.C. 459.)
entries.definition_ko: '사랑하는'이라는 뜻으로 이방인 아내를 취한 브네느보 가문 중 하나이다(에스라 10:43).

entries.definition: (known). • Son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan or Johanan. He is the last of the high priests mentioned in the Old Testament, and probably altogether the latest name in the canon. (Nehemiah 12:11,22) (B.C. 406-332.) • One of the chief of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah. (Nehemiah 10:21) (B.C. 410.)
entries.definition_ko: '알려진'이라는 뜻. (1) 요나단(요하난)을 이은 대제사장으로 구약에 언급된 마지막 대제사장이며 정경에서 가장 후대의 이름일 가능성이 있다(느헤미야 12:11). (2) 느헤미야와 언약을 맺은 백성의 우두머리 중 하나(느헤미야 10:21).

entries.definition: (judge), the Meronothite, who assisted to repair the wall of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 3:7) (B.C. 446.)
entries.definition_ko: '재판관'이라는 뜻으로 메로놋 사람, 예루살렘 성벽 보수를 도왔다(느헤미야 3:7).

entries.definition: (mountain goat), the wife of Heber the Kenite. (B.C. 1316.) In the headlong rout which followed the defeat of the Canaanites by Barak, at Megiddo on the plain of Esdraelon, Sisera, their general, fled to the tent of the Kenite chieftainess, at Kedesh in Naphtali, four miles northwest of Lake Merom. He accepted Jael’s invitation to enter, and she flung a mantle over him as he lay wearily on the floor. When thirst prevented sleep, and he asked for water, she brought him buttermilk in her choicest vessel. At last, with a feeling of perfect security, he feel into a deep sleep. Then it was that Jael took one of the great wooden pins which fastened down the cords of the tent, and with one terrible blow with a mallet dashed it through Sisera’s temples deep into the earth. (Judges 5:27) She then waited to meet the pursuing Barak, and led him into her tent that she might in his presence claim the glory of the deed! Many have supposed that by this act she fulfilled the saying of Deborah, (Judges 4:9) and hence they have supposed that Jael was actuated by some divine and hidden influence. But the Bible gives no hint of such an inspiration.
entries.definition_ko: '산염소'라는 뜻으로 겐 사람 헤벨의 아내이다. 바락에게 패한 가나안 군대의 궤멸 속에서 장군 시스라가 납달리 게데스, 므롬 호수 북서쪽 4마일 지점 겐 족속 족장 아내의 장막으로 도망쳤다. 야엘의 초대를 받아 들어가 지쳐 누웠고 갈증에 물을 청하자 우유를 가장 좋은 그릇에 담아 주었다. 완전한 안심 속에 깊이 잠들자 야엘은 장막 말뚝 하나를 가져와 망치로 한 번에 시스라의 관자놀이를 뚫어 땅에 박아 죽였다(사사기 5:27). 이후 추격해 온 바락을 맞아 장막으로 이끌고 그 앞에서 자신의 공을 알렸다.

entries.definition: (lodging), a town of Judah, one of those farthest to the south, on the frontier of Edom. (Joshua 15:21)
entries.definition_ko: '거처'라는 뜻으로 에돔 접경, 유다 최남단 성읍 중 하나이다(여호수아 15:21).

entries.definition: (Jehovah), the abbreviated form of Jehovah, used only in poetry. It occurs frequently in the Hebrew, but with a single exception, (Psalms 68:4) is rendered “Lord” in the Authorized Version. The identity of Jah and Jehovah is strongly marked in two passages of Isaiah— (Isaiah 12:2; 26:4) [Jehovah].
entries.definition_ko: 여호와의 축약형으로 시가에서만 쓰인다. 히브리어에 자주 나오나 흠정역은 시편 68:4를 제외하고는 모두 '주'로 번역한다. 야와 여호와의 동일성은 이사야 12:2, 26:4에서 뚜렷이 드러난다.

entries.definition: (union). • Son of Libni, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi. (1 Chronicles 6:20) (B.C. after 1706.) • Head of a later house in the family of Gershom, being the eldest son of Shimei, the son of Laadan. (1 Chronicles 23:10,11) • A man in the genealogy of Judah, (1 Chronicles 4:2) son of Reaiah ben-Shobal. • A Levite, son of Shelomoth. (1 Chronicles 24:22) • A Merarite Levite in the reign of Josiah. (2 Chronicles 34:12) (B.C. 623.)
entries.definition_ko: '연합'이라는 뜻. (1) 립니의 아들, 게르솜의 손자(역대상 6:20). (2) 시므이의 맏아들, 게르솜 가문 후대 지도자(역대상 23:10). (3) 유다 족보, 르아야벤소발의 아들(역대상 4:2). (4) 슬로못의 아들, 레위인(역대상 24:22). (5) 요시야 시대 므라리 가문 레위인(역대하 34:12).

entries.definition: (trodden down). Under these four forms is given in the Authorized Version the name of a place which in the Hebrew appears as Yahats and Yahtsah . At Jahaz the decisive battle was fought between the children of Israel and Sihon king of the Amorites. (Numbers 21:23; 2:32; Judges 11:20) It was in the allotment of Reuben. (Joshua 13:18) Like many others relating to the places east of the Dead Sea, the question of its site must await further research.
entries.definition_ko: '짓밟힌'이라는 뜻으로 흠정역에서 네 가지 형태로 표기된다. 이스라엘 자손과 아모리 왕 시혼 사이 결정적 전투가 벌어진 곳이며(민수기 21:23) 르우벤 지파 몫에 속했다(여호수아 13:18). 사해 동쪽 지역의 다른 지명들처럼 정확한 위치는 더 연구가 필요하다.

entries.definition: (trodden down). (Joshua 13:18) [Jahaz, Also Jahaza, Jahazah And Juhzah]
entries.definition_ko: '짓밟힌'(여호수아 13:18). 야하스(JAHAZ) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (trodden down). (Joshua 21:36; Jeremiah 48:21) [Jahaz, Also Jahaza, Jahazah And Juhzah]
entries.definition_ko: '짓밟힌'(여호수아 21:36). 야하스(JAHAZ) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (whom God watches over) • One of the heroes of Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag. (1 Chronicles 12:4) (B.C. 1055.) • A priest in the reign of David. (1 Chronicles 16:6) • A Kohathite Levite, third son of Hebron. (1 Chronicles 23:19; 24:23) • Son of Zechariah, a Levite of the Bene-Asaph in the reign of Jehoshaphat. (2 Chronicles 20:14) (B.C. 896.) • The “son of Jahaziel” was the chief of the Bene-Shecaniah who returned from Babylon with Ezra. (Ezra 8:5) (B.C. before 459.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 지켜보시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 시글락에서 다윗에게 합류한 베냐민 용사 중 하나(역대상 12:4). (2) 다윗 시대 제사장(역대상 16:6). (3) 헤브론의 셋째 아들, 고핫 가문 레위인(역대상 23:19). (4) 스가랴의 아들, 여호사밧 시대 아삽 자손 레위인(역대하 20:14). (5) '야하시엘의 아들'은 에스라와 함께 바벨론에서 돌아온 브네스가냐의 우두머리였다(에스라 8:5).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah directs), a man who appears to be thrust abruptly into the genealogy of Caleb, as the father of six sons. (1 Chronicles 2:47)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 인도하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 갈렙 족보에 갑자기 등장하는 인물, 여섯 아들의 아버지이다(역대상 2:47).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah makes joyful), a chieftain of Manasseh on the east of Jordan. (1 Chronicles 5:24) (B.C. 320.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 기쁘게 하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 요단 동편 므낫세 지파 지도자였다(역대상 5:24).

entries.definition: (united), a Gadite, (1 Chronicles 5:14) son of Buz and father of Jeshishai.
entries.definition_ko: '연합된'이라는 뜻으로 갓 사람, 부스의 아들이자 여시새의 아버지이다(역대상 5:14).

entries.definition: (hoping in Jehovah), the third of the three sons of Zebulun, (Genesis 46:14; Numbers 26:26) founder of the family of Jahleelites. (B.C. 1706.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께 소망을 두는 자'라는 뜻으로 스불론의 세 아들 중 셋째이며 야흘르엘 자손의 조상이다(창세기 46:14).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah guards), a man of Issachar, one of the heads of the house of Tolah. (1 Chronicles 7:2) (B.C. 1491)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 지키시는 자'라는 뜻으로 잇사갈 사람, 돌라 가문 지도자 중 하나이다(역대상 7:2).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah watches over), son of Tikvah, apparently a priest. (Ezra 10:15)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 지켜보시는 자'라는 뜻으로 디그와의 아들, 제사장으로 추정된다(에스라 10:15).

entries.definition: (trodden down). (1 Chronicles 6:78) [Jahaz, Also Jahaza, Jahazah And Juhzah]
entries.definition_ko: '짓밟힌'(역대상 6:78). 야하스(JAHAZ) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (whom God allots), the first of the four sons of Naphtali, (Genesis 46:24) founder of the family of the Jahzeelites. (Numbers 26:48) (B.C. 1306.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 나누어주신 자'라는 뜻으로 납달리의 네 아들 중 첫째이며 야스엘 자손의 조상이다(창세기 46:24).

entries.definition: (whom God leads back), a priest of the house of Immer. (1 Chronicles 9:12)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 돌아오게 하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 임멜 가문 제사장이다(역대상 9:12).

entries.definition: (whom God allots), the same as Jahzeel. (1 Chronicles 7:13)
entries.definition_ko: 야스엘(JAHZEEL)과 동일하다(역대상 7:13).

entries.definition: (enlightener). • A man who on his father’s side was descended from Judah, and on his mother’s from Manasseh. (B.C. 1451.) During, the conquest he took the whole of the tract of Argob (3:14) and in addition possessed himself of some nomad villages in Gilead, which he called after his own name Havoth-Jair. (Numbers 32:41; 1 Chronicles 2:23) • JAIR THE GILEADITE, who judged Israel for two-and-twenty years. (Judges 10:3-5) (B.C. 1160.) He had thirty sons, and possessed thirty cities in the land of Gilead, which like those of their namesakes were called Havoth-jair. • A Benjamite, son of Kish and father of Mordecai. (Esther 2:5) (B.C. before 598.) • The father of Elhanan, one of the heroes of David’s army. (1 Chronicles 20:6)
entries.definition_ko: '빛을 비추는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 아버지 쪽으로는 유다, 어머니 쪽으로는 므낫세 혈통을 이은 인물로 정복 중 아르곱 전 지역을 차지하고 길르앗의 여러 유목 마을들도 얻어 자기 이름을 따 하봇야일이라 불렀다(민수기 32:41). (2) 길르앗 사람 야일, 이스라엘을 22년간 다스린 사사로 서른 아들을 두었고 길르앗 땅에 서른 성읍을 소유해 역시 하봇야일이라 불렸다(사사기 10:3). (3) 베냐민 사람, 기스의 아들이자 모르드개의 아버지(에스더 2:5). (4) 다윗 군대 용사 엘하난의 아버지(역대상 20:6).

entries.definition: (descendant of Jair). The IraTHE JAIRITE was a priest (Authorized Version “chief ruler”) to David (2 Samuel 20:26)
entries.definition_ko: '야일의 후손'이라는 뜻으로 '야일 사람 이라'는 다윗의 제사장이었다(사무엘하 20:26).

entries.definition: (whom God enlightens). • A ruler of a synagogue, probably in some town near the western shore of the Sea of Galilee. (Matthew 9:18; Mark 5:22; Luke 8:41) (A.D. 28.) • (Esther 11:2) [Jair, 3]
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 비추시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 갈릴리 호수 서쪽 어느 마을의 회당장(마태복음 9:18). (2) 야일(3번) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (who gathers the people together), a Levite in the time of King David; fourth of the sons of Hebron, the son of Kohath. (1 Chronicles 23:19; 24:23) (B.C. 1014.)
entries.definition_ko: '백성을 모으는 자'라는 뜻으로 다윗 시대 레위인, 고핫의 아들 헤브론의 넷째 아들이다(역대상 23:19).

entries.definition: (sagacious), son of Ezer the Horite. (1 Chronicles 1:42) The same as JaakanJAAkan. [And see Akan]
entries.definition_ko: '현명한'이라는 뜻으로 호리 사람 에셀의 아들이다(역대상 1:42). 야아간(JAAKAN)과 동일하다.

entries.definition: (pious). [Proverbs, Book Of, BookOF]
entries.definition_ko: '경건한'이라는 뜻. 잠언(PROVERBS, BOOK OF) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (whom God sets up). • Head of the twelfth course of priests in the reign of David. (1 Chronicles 24:12) (B.C. 1014.) • A Benjamite, one of the Bene-Shimhi. (1 Chronicles 8:19) (B.C. 588.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 세우시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 다윗 시대 제사장 열두째 반차의 우두머리(역대상 24:12). (2) 베냐민 사람, 브네시므이 가문(역대상 8:19).

entries.definition: (abiding), one of the sons of Ezra. (1 Chronicles 4:17)
entries.definition_ko: '머무는'이라는 뜻으로 에스라의 아들 중 하나이다(역대상 4:17).

entries.definition: [JannesAND JAMBRES]
entries.definition_ko: 얀네와 얌브레(JANNES AND JAMBRES) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (the Greek form of Jacob, supplanter). • James the son of Zebedee, one of the twelve apostles. He was elder brother of the evangelist John. His mother’s name was Salome. We first hear of him in A.D. 27, (Mark 1:20) when at the call of the Master he left all, and became, one and forever, his disciple, in the spring of 28. (Matthew 10:2; Mark 3:14; Luke 6:13; Acts 1:13) It would seem to have been at the time of the appointment of the twelve apostles that the name of Boanerges was given to the sons of Zebedee. The “sons of thunder” had a burning and impetuous spirit, which twice exhibits itself. (Mark 10:37; Luke 9:54) On the night before the crucifixion James was present at the agony in the garden. On the day of the ascension he is mentioned as persevering with the rest of the apostles and disciples, in prayer. (Acts 1:13) Shortly before the day of the Passover, in the year 44, he was put to death by Herod Agrippa I. (Acts 12:1,2) • James the son of Alpheus, one of the twelve apostles. (Matthew 10:3) Whether or not this James is to be identified with James the Less, the son of Alphaeus, the brother of our Lord, is one of the most difficult questions in the gospel history. By comparing (Matthew 27:56) and Mark 15:40with John 19:25We find that the Virgin Mary had a sister named, like herself, Mary, who was the wife of Clopas or Alpheus (varieties of the same name), and who had two sons, James the Less and Joses. By referring to (Matthew 13:55) and Mark 6:3We find that a James the Less and Joses, with two other brethren called Jude and Simon, and at least three sisters, were sisters with the Virgin Mary at Nazareth by referring to (Luke 6:16) and Acts 1:13We find that there were two brethren named James and Jude among the apostles. It would certainly be natural to think that we had here but one family of four brothers and three or more sisters, the children of Clopas and Mary, nephews and nieces of the Virgin Mary. There are difficulties however, in the way of this conclusion into which we cannot here enter; but in reply to the objection that the four brethren in (Matthew 13:55) are described as the brothers of Jesus, not as his cousins, it must be recollected that adelphoi, which is here translated “brethren,” may also signify cousins.
entries.definition_ko: (야곱의 헬라식 표기, '발뒤꿈치를 잡는 자'). (1) 세베대의 아들 야고보, 열두 사도 중 하나이자 요한의 형이며 어머니는 살로메였다. 주후 27년경 부름받아 제자가 되었고(마가복음 1:20) 이때 '보아너게(우레의 아들)'라는 별명을 얻은 것으로 보이는데 이는 격렬하고 열정적인 성품 때문이었다(마가복음 10:37). 십자가 전날 겟세마네 동산에서 함께 있었고 승천일에도 다른 제자들과 함께 기도했다(사도행전 1:13). 주후 44년경 헤롯 아그립바 1세에게 죽임당했다(사도행전 12:1). (2) 알패오의 아들 야고보, 열두 사도 중 하나(마태복음 10:3)로 '작은 야고보', 곧 주님의 형제와 동일 인물인지는 복음서 역사에서 가장 어려운 문제 중 하나이다.

entries.definition: called the Less because younger or smaller in stature than James the son of Zebedee. He was the son of Alpheus or Clopas and brother of our Lord (see above); was called to the apostolate, together with his younger brother Jude, in the spring of the year 28. At some time in the forty days that intervened between the resurrection and the ascension the Lord appeared to him. (1 Corinthians 15:7) Ten years after we find James on a level with Peter, and with him deciding on the admission of St. Paul into fellowship with the Church at Jerusalem; and from henceforth we always find him equal, or in his own department superior, to the very chiefest apostles, Peter, John and Paul. (Acts 9:27; Galatians 1:18,19) This pre-eminence is evident throughout the after history of the apostles, whether we read it in the Acts, in the epistles or in ecclesiastical writers. (Acts 12:17; 15:13,19; 21:18; Galatians 2:9) According to tradition, James was thrown down from the temple by the scribes and Pharisees; he was then stoned, and his brains dashed out with a fuller’s club.
entries.definition_ko: 세베대의 아들 야고보보다 나이가 어리거나 체구가 작아 '작은 야고보'라 불렸다. 알패오(글로바)의 아들이자 주님의 형제였으며 동생 유다와 함께 주후 28년 봄 사도로 부름받았다. 부활과 승천 사이 어느 시점 주님이 그에게 나타나셨다(고린도전서 15:7). 10년 후 베드로와 대등한 위치에서 바울의 예루살렘 교회 교제 허입을 함께 결정했으며 이후로도 항상 베드로·요한·바울에 버금가거나 자기 영역에서는 그들보다 우위에 있는 것으로 나타난다(사도행전 15:13). 전승에 따르면 서기관과 바리새인들에게 성전에서 떠밀려 떨어진 후 돌에 맞고 세탁공의 방망이에 맞아 죽었다.

entries.definition: The author of this epistle was in all probability James the son of Alphaeus, and our Lord’s brother It was written from Jerusalem, which St. James does not seem to have ever left. It was probably written about A.D. 62, during the interval between Paul’s two imprisonments. Its main object is not to teach doctrine, but to improve morality. St. James is the moral teacher of the New Testament. He wrote for the Jewish Christians, whether in Jerusalem or abroad, to warn them against the sins to which as Jews they were most liable, and to console and exhort them under the sufferings to which as Christians they were most exposed.
entries.definition_ko: 저자는 거의 확실히 알패오의 아들 야고보, 곧 주님의 형제이며 예루살렘을 떠난 적이 없는 것으로 보인다. 주후 62년경, 바울의 두 차례 투옥 사이에 기록된 것으로 보인다. 교리보다 도덕 실천을 강조하는 신약의 도덕 교사로서, 예루살렘 안팎의 유대인 그리스도인들에게 유대인으로서 특히 빠지기 쉬운 죄를 경고하고 그리스도인으로서 겪는 고난 중에 위로와 권면을 전하기 위해 썼다.

entries.definition: (right hand). • Second son of Simeon, (Genesis46:10; Exod 6:15; 1Chr 4:24Founder of the family of the Jaminites. (Numbers 26:12) (B.C. 1706.) • A man of Judah, second son of Ram the Jerahmeelite. (1 Chronicles 2:27) • One of the Levites who expounded the law to the people. (Nehemiah 8:7) (B.C. 410.)
entries.definition_ko: '오른손'이라는 뜻. (1) 시므온의 둘째 아들, 야민 자손의 조상(창세기 46:10). (2) 여라므엘 사람 람의 둘째 아들, 유다 사람(역대상 2:27). (3) 백성에게 율법을 해설한 레위인 중 하나(느헤미야 8:7).

entries.definition: (whom God makes king), one of the chief men of the tribe of Simeon. (1 Chronicles 4:34)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 왕이 되게 하신 자'라는 뜻으로 시므온 지파 지도자 중 하나이다(역대상 4:34).

entries.definition: [Jabneel]
entries.definition_ko: 얍느엘(JABNEEL) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (flourishing), son of Joseph, and father of Melchi, in the genealogy of Christ. (Luke 3:24) In the Revised Version written JANNAI.
entries.definition_ko: '번성하는'이라는 뜻으로 요셉의 아들이자 멜기의 아버지, 그리스도의 족보에 나온다(누가복음 3:24). 개정역에서는 얀나이로 표기된다.

entries.definition: and Jam’bres, the names of two Egyptian magicians who opposed Moses. Exod 7:9-13; 2Tim 3:8,9. (B.C. 1492.)
entries.definition_ko: 얀네와 얌브레는 모세를 대적한 두 애굽 마술사의 이름이다(디모데후서 3:8).

entries.definition: (rest), a place apparently in the north of Galilee, or the “land of Naphtali,”—one of those taken by Tiglath-pileser in his first incursion into Palestine. (2 Kings 15:29) No trace of it appears elsewhere.
entries.definition_ko: '쉼'이라는 뜻으로 갈릴리 북부, '납달리 땅'에 있는 곳으로 보이며 디글랏빌레셀의 첫 팔레스타인 침공 때 함락된 곳 중 하나이다(열왕기하 15:29). 다른 곳에는 흔적이 없다.

entries.definition: (rest), a place on the boundary of Ephraim (Joshua 16:6,7) east of Neapolis. A little less than twelve miles from Nablus and about southeast in direction, two miles from Akrabeh is the village of Yanun, doubtless identical with the ancient Janohah.
entries.definition_ko: '쉼'이라는 뜻으로 에브라임 경계의 한 장소이며(여호수아 16:6) 나블루스에서 남동쪽 약 12마일, 아크라베에서 2마일 거리의 마을 야눈과 동일시된다.

entries.definition: (slumber), a town of Judah in the mountain district, apparently not far from Hebron. (Joshua 15:53)
entries.definition_ko: '졸음'이라는 뜻으로 헤브론에서 멀지 않은 유다 산악 지대의 성읍이다(여호수아 15:53).

entries.definition: (enlargement), one of the three sons of Noah. The descendants of Japheth occupied the “isles of the Gentiles,” (Genesis 10:5)—i.e. the coast lands of the Mediterranean Sea in Europe and Asia Minor— whence they spread northward over the whole continent of Europe and a considerable portion of Asia.
entries.definition_ko: '확장'이라는 뜻으로 노아의 세 아들 중 하나이다. 그 후손은 '이방인의 섬들'(지중해 연안 유럽과 소아시아 해안)을 차지했고(창세기 10:5) 이후 유럽 전역과 아시아 상당 부분으로 퍼져나갔다.

entries.definition: (splendid). • King of Lachish at the time of the conquest of Canaan by the Israelites. (Joshua 10:3) (B.C. 1450.) • One of the sons of David born to him in Jerusalem. (2 Samuel 5:15; 1 Chronicles 3:7; 14:6) (B.C. 1046.) (splended) The boundary of Zebulun ascended from Daberath to Japhia, and thence passed to Gath-hepher. (Joshua 19:12) Yafa, two miles south of Nazareth, is not unlikely to be identical with Japhin.
entries.definition_ko: '찬란한'이라는 뜻. (1) 이스라엘의 가나안 정복 당시 라기스 왕(여호수아 10:3). (2) 예루살렘에서 태어난 다윗의 아들 중 하나(사무엘하 5:15). (3) 스불론 경계의 지표로 다브랏에서 야비아로 올라가 갓헤벨로 이어진다(여호수아 19:12). 나사렛 남쪽 2마일의 야파가 이곳으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (the Japhletite). The boundary of the “Japhletite” is one of the landmarks on the south boundary line of Ephraim. (Joshua 16:3)
entries.definition_ko: '야블렛 사람'이라는 뜻으로 에브라임 남쪽 경계의 지표 중 하나로 쓰인 부족명이다(여호수아 16:3).

entries.definition: (whom God delivers) a descendant of Asher through Beriah. (1 Chronicles 7:32,33)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 구원하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 브리아를 통한 아셀의 후손이다(역대상 7:32).

entries.definition: (beauty). (John 19:46) The Hebrew form for the better-known Joppa, Or Japho. (2 Chronicles 2:16; Ezra 3:7; Jonah 1:3) In its modern garb it is Yafa .
entries.definition_ko: '아름다움'이라는 뜻으로(여호수아 19:46) 더 잘 알려진 욥바(요바)의 히브리식 표기이다(역대하 2:16). 오늘날 야파로 남아 있다.

entries.definition: (honey), a descendant of Saul; son of Micah and great-grandson of Mephibosheth. (1 Chronicles 9:42) comp. 1Chr 9:40
entries.definition_ko: '꿀'이라는 뜻으로 사울의 후손, 미가의 아들이자 므비보셋의 증손이다(역대상 9:42).

entries.definition: (adversary) is to be explained either as the proper name of a country or person, as a noun in apposition, or as a verb from a root, rub, “to contend plead.” All these senses are represented in the Authorized Version and the marginal readings, (Hosea 5:13; 10:6) and the east preferable has been inserted in the text. Jareb is most probably the name of some city of Assyria or another name of the country itself.
entries.definition_ko: '대적자'라는 뜻으로 나라 또는 인물의 고유명사, 동격 명사, 혹은 '다투다'를 뜻하는 어근에서 온 동사로 다양하게 해석된다(호세아 5:13). 아마도 앗수르의 한 도시 이름이거나 그 나라 자체의 또 다른 이름으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (descent), one of the antediluvian patriarchs, and further of Enoch (Genesis 5:15,16,18-20; Luke 3:37) In the lists of Chronicles the name is given in the Authorized Version Jered.
entries.definition_ko: '하강'이라는 뜻으로 홍수 이전 족장 중 하나이며 에녹의 아버지이다(창세기 5:15). 역대기 목록에서는 흠정역에서 예렛으로 표기된다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah nourishes), a Benjamite, one of the Bene-Jehoram. (1 Chronicles 8:17)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 기르시는 자'라는 뜻으로 베냐민 사람, 브네여호람 가문이다(역대상 8:27).

entries.definition: the Egyptian servant of Sheshan, about the time of Eli, to whom his master gave his daughter and heir in marriage; (1 Chronicles 2:34,35) (B.C. before 1491.)
entries.definition_ko: 엘리 시대 무렵 세산의 애굽 사람 종으로 주인이 그에게 딸이자 상속녀를 아내로 주었다(역대상 2:34).

entries.definition: (adversary). • Named in the list of (1 Chronicles 4:24) only, as a son of Simeon. Perhaps the same as Jachin. Genesis46; Exod 6; Numb 26. • One of the “chief men” who accompanied Ezra on his journey from Babylon to Jerusalem. (Ezra 8:16) (B.C. 469.) • A priest of the house of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, who had married a foreign wife, and was compelled by Ezra to put her away. (Ezra 10:18) (B.C. 459.) •1 Macc. 14:29. A contraction or corruption of the name JOARIB. ch. 2:1.
entries.definition_ko: '대적자'라는 뜻. (1) 역대상 4:24에만 언급되는 시므온의 아들, 야긴과 동일 인물일 가능성. (2) 에스라와 함께 바벨론에서 예루살렘으로 온 '지도자들' 중 하나(에스라 8:16). (3) 여호사닥의 아들 예수아 가문 제사장으로 이방인 아내를 두어 에스라의 명으로 내보냄(에스라 10:18).

entries.definition: (heights). 1 Esd. 9:28. [Jeremoth]
entries.definition_ko: '높음'이라는 뜻(에스드라1서 9:28). 여레못(JEREMOTH) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (high). • A town in the low country of Judah. (Joshua 16:35) Its king, Piram, was one of the five who conspired. to punish Gibeon for having made alliance with Israel, (Joshua 10:3,5) and who were routed at Beth-horon and put to death by Joshua at Makkedah. ver. 33. Its site is probably the modern Yarmuk . • A city of Issachar allotted with its suburbs to the Gershonite Levites. (Joshua 21:29)
entries.definition_ko: '높은'이라는 뜻. (1) 유다 저지대의 성읍(여호수아 15:35). 그 왕 비람은 기브온을 벌하기 위해 동맹한 다섯 왕 중 하나로 벧호론에서 패해 막게다에서 여호수아에게 처형당했다(여호수아 10:3). 오늘날 야르무크로 추정된다. (2) 잇사갈의 성읍으로 게르손 가문 레위인에게 배정됨(여호수아 21:29).

entries.definition: (moon), a chief man of the tribe of Gad (1 Chronicles 5:14)
entries.definition_ko: '달'이라는 뜻으로 갓 지파 지도자였다(역대상 5:14).

entries.definition: (sleeping). Bene-Jashen—“sons of Jashen”— are named in the catalogue of the heroes of David’s guard in (2 Samuel 23:32) (B.C. 1046.)
entries.definition_ko: '잠자는'이라는 뜻으로 '브네야센'(야센의 아들들)이 다윗의 근위 용사 목록에 나온다(사무엘하 23:32).

entries.definition: (upright),Book of (“the book of the upright”), alluded to in two passages only of the Old Testament. (Joshua 10:13) and 2Sam 1:18It was probably written in verse; and it has been conjectured that it was a collection of ancient records of honored men or noble deeds. It is wholly lost.
entries.definition_ko: '의로운 자의 책'이라는 뜻으로 구약에 두 번만 언급된다(여호수아 10:13). 시 형태로 기록되었을 것으로 추정되며 존귀한 인물이나 고귀한 행적을 모은 고대 기록집이었을 것으로 짐작되나 완전히 소실되었다.

entries.definition: (to whom the people turn), named first among the chief of the mighty men of David. (1 Chronicles 11:11) (B.C. 1046.) He came to David at Ziklag. His distinguishing exploit was that he slew 300 (or 800,) (2 Samuel 23:8) men at one time.
entries.definition_ko: '백성이 그에게로 향하는 자'라는 뜻으로 다윗의 용사 중 으뜸으로 꼽힌다(역대상 11:11). 시글락에서 다윗에게 왔으며 한 번에 300명(또는 800명)을 죽인 일화로 유명하다(사무엘하 23:8).

entries.definition: (he turns). • The third son of Issachar, and founder of the family of the Jashubites. (Numbers 26:24; 1 Chronicles 7:1) (B.C. 1706.) • One of the sons of Bani, who had to put away his foreign wife. (Ezra 10:29) (B.C. 459.)
entries.definition_ko: '그가 돌아온다'는 뜻. (1) 잇사갈의 셋째 아들, 야숩 자손의 조상(민수기 26:24). (2) 이방인 아내를 내보낸 바니의 아들 중 하나(에스라 10:29).

entries.definition: (turner back for food), a person or a place named among the descendants of Shelah, the son of Judah by Bath-shua the Canaanitess. (1 Chronicles 4:22)
entries.definition_ko: '양식을 위해 돌아오는 자'라는 뜻으로 유다가 가나안 여인 밧수아를 통해 낳은 셀라의 후손 목록에 나오는 인물 또는 지명이다(역대상 4:22).

entries.definition: (whom God made), the last named on the list of David’s heroes in (1 Chronicles 11:47)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 만드신 자'라는 뜻으로 다윗의 용사 목록 마지막에 나온다(역대상 11:47).

entries.definition: (one who will heal), called the Thessalonian, entertained Paul and Silas, and was in consequence attacked by the Jewish mob. (Acts 17:5,6,7,9) (A.D. 48.) He is probably the same as the Jason mentioned in (Romans 16:21) It is conjectured that Jason and Secundus, (Acts 20:4) were the same.
entries.definition_ko: '고칠 자'라는 뜻으로 데살로니가 사람으로 바울과 실라를 자기 집에 머물게 했다가 유대인 폭도의 공격을 받았다(사도행전 17:5). 로마서 16:21의 야손과 동일 인물로 추정된다.

entries.definition: a precious stone frequently noticed in Scripture. It was the last of the twelve inserted in the high priest’s breastplate, (Exodus 28:20; 39:13) and the first of the twelve used in the foundations of the new Jerusalem. (Revelation 21:19) The characteristics of the stone as far as they are specified in Scripture, (Revelation 21:11) are that it “was most precious,” and “like crystal;” we may also infer from (Revelation 4:3) that it was a stone of brilliant and transparent light. The stone which we name “jasper” does not accord with this description. There can be no doubt that the diamond would more adequately answer to the description in the book of Revelation.
entries.definition_ko: 성경에 자주 언급되는 보석으로 대제사장 흉패의 열두 보석 중 마지막이었고(출애굽기 28:20) 새 예루살렘 기초석 열두 개 중 첫째로 쓰였다(계시록 21:19). '가장 귀하고 수정 같다'(계시록 21:11)는 특징으로 보아 찬란하고 투명한 빛을 지닌 보석으로 짐작되며 오늘날의 벽옥보다는 다이아몬드에 더 가까울 것으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (whom God gives), a Korhite Levite, the fourth of the family of Meshelemiah. (1 Chronicles 26:2) (B.C. 1014.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 주시는 자'라는 뜻으로 고라 가문 레위인, 므셀레먀 가문의 넷째이다(역대상 26:2).

entries.definition: (pre-eminent), a town of Judah in the mountain districts, (Joshua 15:48) one of the group containing Socho, Eshtemoa, etc. See also (Joshua 21:14; 1 Samuel 30:27; 1 Chronicles 6:57) By Robinson it is identified with ’Attir, six miles north of Molada and ten miles south of Hebron.
entries.definition_ko: '뛰어난'이라는 뜻으로 유다 산악 지대 성읍이며(여호수아 15:48) 소고·에스드모아 등과 함께 한 무리에 속한다. 로빈슨은 몰라다 북쪽 6마일, 헤브론 남쪽 10마일의 아티르와 동일시한다.

entries.definition: (clay). • A son of Japheth. (Genesis 10:2,4) Javan was regarded as the representative of the Greek race. The name was probably introduced into Asia by the Phoenicians, to whom the Ionians were naturally better known than any other of the Hellenic races, on account of their commercial activity and the high prosperity of their towns on the western coast of Asia Minor. • A town in the souther part of Arabia (Yemen), whither the Phoenicians traded. (Ezekiel 27:19)
entries.definition_ko: '진흙'이라는 뜻. (1) 야벳의 아들(창세기 10:2)로 헬라 민족을 대표하는 인물로 여겨진다. 이 이름은 상업 활동이 활발했던 이오니아인들을 통해 페니키아인들이 아시아에 소개했을 것으로 추정된다. (2) 페니키아인들이 무역한 남부 아라비아(예멘)의 한 도시(에스겔 27:19).

entries.definition: [Arms, Armor]
entries.definition_ko: 무기·갑옷(ARMS, ARMOR) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (Jehovah helps). [Jaazer, Or Jazer]
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 도우신다'는 뜻. 야셀(JAAZER, OR JAZER) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (whom God moves), a Hagarite who had charge of the flocks of King David. (1 Chronicles 27:31) (B.C. 1046.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 움직이시는 자'라는 뜻으로 하갈 사람, 다윗 왕의 양떼를 관리했다(역대상 27:31).

entries.definition: (forests), Mount, a place named in specifying the northern boundary of Judah. (Joshua 15:10) The boundary ran from Mount Seir to “the shoulder of Mount Jearim, which is Cesalon”—that is, Cesalon was the landmark on the mountain. Kesla, seven miles due west of Jerusalem, stands on a high point on the north slope of a lofty ridge, which is probably Mount Jearim.
entries.definition_ko: '숲들'이라는 뜻으로 유다 북쪽 경계 지표로 언급되는 산 이름이다(여호수아 15:10). 경계가 세일산에서 '여아림산 어깨, 곧 그살론'으로 이어졌다. 예루살렘 서쪽 정확히 7마일의 케슬라가 이 산 북쪽 경사면 높은 지점에 있어 여아림산으로 추정된다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah leads), a Gershonite Levite, son of Zerah. (1 Chronicles 6:21)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 인도하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 게르손 가문 레위인, 세라의 아들이다(역대상 6:21).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah blesses), father of a certain Zechariah, in the reign of Ahaz, mentioned (Isaiah 8:2) (B.C. about 739.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 복 주시는 자'라는 뜻으로 아하스 시대 스가랴의 아버지이다(이사야 8:2).

entries.definition: (threshing-floor), one of the names of Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites, are called Jebusi. (Joshua 15:8; 18:16,28; Judges 19:10,11; 1 Chronicles 11:4,5) [Jerusalem]
entries.definition_ko: '타작마당'이라는 뜻으로 예루살렘, 여부스 족속의 성읍의 옛 이름 중 하나이다(여호수아 15:8).

entries.definition: (from Jebus), the name employed for the city of Jebus. (Joshua 15:8; 18:16,28)
entries.definition_ko: 여부스(JEBUS) 성읍을 가리키는 데 쓰인 이름이다(여호수아 15:8).

entries.definition: (descendants of Jebus), The, were descended from the third son of Canaan. (Genesis 10:16; 1 Chronicles 1:14) The actual people first appear in the invaluable report of the spies. (Numbers 13:29) When Jabin organized his rising against Joshua, the Jebusites joined him. (Joshua 11:3) “Jebus, which is Jerusalem,” lost its king in the slaughter of Beth-horon, (Joshua 10:1,5,26) comp. Josh 12:10Was sacked and burned by the men of Judah, (Judges 1:21) and its citadel finally scaled and occupied by David. (2 Samuel 5:6) After this they emerge from the darkness but once, in the person of Araunah the Jebusite, “Araunah the king,” who appears before us in true kingly dignity in his wellknown transaction with David. (2 Samuel 24:23; 1 Chronicles 21:24,25)
entries.definition_ko: 가나안의 셋째 아들 여부스에게서 나온 후손이다(창세기 10:16). 정탐꾼들의 보고에 처음 등장하며(민수기 13:29) 야빈이 여호수아에 맞서 봉기를 조직할 때 합류했다(여호수아 11:3). '여부스, 곧 예루살렘'은 벧호론 전투에서 왕을 잃었고(여호수아 10:1) 유다 사람들에게 함락·소각되었으며(사사기 1:21) 그 요새는 마침내 다윗에게 점령되었다(사무엘하 5:6). 이후 여부스 사람 아라우나('아라우나 왕')가 다윗과의 유명한 거래에서 왕다운 위엄을 보이며 등장한다(사무엘하 24:23).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah gathers), one of seven who were introduced into the royal line, on the failure of it in the person of Jehoiachin. (1 Chronicles 3:18)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 모으시는 자'라는 뜻으로 여호야긴 대에서 끊긴 왕통을 잇기 위해 세워진 일곱 명 중 하나이다(역대상 3:18).

entries.definition: (strong through Jehovah) wife of Amaziah king of Judah, and mother of Azariah or Uzziah his successor. (2 Kings 15:2) (B.C. 824-807.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와로 인해 강한'이라는 뜻으로 유다 왕 아마샤의 아내이자 후계자 아사랴(웃시야)의 어머니이다(열왕기하 15:2).

entries.definition: The same as Jecholiah. (2 Chronicles 26:3)
entries.definition_ko: 여골리야(JECHOLIAH)와 동일하다(역대하 26:3).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah establishes). [See Jehoiachin]
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 세우시는 자'라는 뜻. 여호야긴(JEHOIACHIN) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: the Greek form of Jeconiah, an altered form of Jehoiachin. [Jehoiachin]
entries.definition_ko: 여고냐의 헬라식 표기, 여호야긴의 변형이다. 여호야긴(JEHOIACHIN) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: • A Simeonite, forefather of Ziza. (1 Chronicles 4:37) • Son of Harumaph; a man who did his part in the rebuilding of the wall of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 3:10) (B.C. 446.) (praise Jehovah). • Head of the second course of priests, as they were divided in the time of David. (1 Chronicles 24:7) (B.C. 1014.) some of them survived to return to Jerusalem after the Babylonish captivity, as appears from (Ezra 2:36; Nehemiah 7:39) • A priest in the time of Jeshua the high priest. (Zechariah 6:10,14) (B.C. 536.)
entries.definition_ko: (1) 시므온 사람, 시사의 조상(역대상 4:37). (2) 하루맙의 아들, 예루살렘 성벽 재건에 참여(느헤미야 3:10). (3) '여호와를 찬양하라'는 뜻으로 다윗 시대 제사장 둘째 반차의 우두머리(역대상 24:7), 그 후손 일부가 포로 후 예루살렘으로 귀환(에스라 2:36). (4) 대제사장 예수아 시대 제사장(스가랴 6:10).

entries.definition: (known of God). • A chief patriarch of the tribe of Benjamin. (1 Chronicles 7:6,11) It is usually assumed that Jediael is the same as Ashbel, (Genesis 46:21; Numbers 26:38; 1 Chronicles 8:1) but this is not certain. • Second son of Meshelemiah, a Levite. (1 Chronicles 26:1,2) • Son of Shimri; one of the heroes of David’s guard. (1 Chronicles 11:45) (B.C. 1046.) • One of the chiefs of the thousands of Manasseh who joined David on his march to Ziklag. (1 Chronicles 12:20) comp. 1Sam 30:9,10(B.C. 1053.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님께 알려진'이라는 뜻. (1) 베냐민 지파 족장(역대상 7:6). (2) 레위인 므셀레먀의 둘째 아들(역대상 26:1). (3) 시므리의 아들, 다윗의 근위 용사 중 하나(역대상 11:45). (4) 시글락으로 다윗을 찾아온 므낫세 지파 천부장 지도자 중 하나(역대상 12:20).

entries.definition: (one beloved), queen of Amon and mother of the good king Josiah. (2 Kings 22:1) (B.C. 648.)
entries.definition_ko: '사랑받는 자'라는 뜻으로 아몬의 왕비이자 선한 왕 요시야의 어머니이다(열왕기하 22:1).

entries.definition: (beloved of Jehovah), Jedid-jah (darling of Jehovah), the name bestowed, through Nathan the prophet, on David’s son Solomon. (2 Samuel 12:25)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와의 사랑을 입은 자'라는 뜻으로 선지자 나단을 통해 다윗의 아들 솔로몬에게 붙여진 이름이다(사무엘하 12:25).

entries.definition: (praising), a Levite of the family of Merari, is probably the same as Ethan. Comp. (1 Chronicles 15:17,19) with 1Chr 16:41,42; 25:1,3,6; 2Chr 35:15His office was generally to preside over the music of the temple service, Jeduthun’s name stands at the head of the 39th, 62d and 77th Psalms, indicating probably that they were to be sung by his choir. (B.C. 1014.)
entries.definition_ko: '찬양하는'이라는 뜻으로 므라리 가문 레위인이며 에단과 동일 인물로 추정된다. 성전 봉사 음악을 주관하는 직책을 맡았으며 시편 39편, 62편, 77편 표제에 그의 이름이 나와 그의 성가대가 부르도록 지정된 것으로 보인다.

entries.definition: (father of help), (Numbers 26:30) the name of a descendant of Manasseh and founder of the family of the Jeezerites. In parallel lists the name is given as ABI-EZER.
entries.definition_ko: '도움의 아버지'라는 뜻으로 므낫세의 후손, 여이셀 자손의 조상이다(민수기 26:30). 병행 목록에서는 아비에셀로 나온다.

entries.definition: (heap of testimony), the Aramaean name given by Laban the Syrian to the heap of stones which he erected as a memorial of the compact between Jacob and himself. (Genesis 31:47) Galeed, a “witness heap,” which is given as the Hebrew equivalent, does not exactly represent Jegar-sahadutha.
entries.definition_ko: '증거의 무더기'라는 뜻으로 수리아 사람 라반이 야곱과 자신 사이의 계약을 기념해 쌓은 돌무더기에 붙인 아람어 이름이다(창세기 31:47). 히브리어 상응어인 '갈르엣'(증거의 무더기)과 정확히 같은 뜻은 아니다.

entries.definition: (who praises God). Four men of the Bene-Jehaleleel are introduced abruptly into the genealogies of Judah. (1 Chronicles 4:16)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님을 찬양하는 자'라는 뜻으로 유다 족보에 갑작스레 등장하는 브네여할렐렐 네 사람이다(역대상 4:16).

entries.definition: (who praises God), a Merarite Levite, father of Azariah. (2 Chronicles 29:12)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님을 찬양하는 자'라는 뜻으로 므라리 가문 레위인, 아사랴의 아버지이다(역대하 29:12).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah makes glad). • The representative of the Bene-Shubael, in the time of David. (1 Chronicles 24:20) • A Meronothite who had charge of the she-asses of David. (1 Chronicles 27:30) (B.C. 1046.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 기쁘게 하시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 다윗 시대 브네수바엘의 대표(역대상 24:20). (2) 메로놋 사람, 다윗의 암나귀들을 관리(역대상 27:30).

entries.definition: (whom God makes strong), a priest to whom was given by David the charge of the twentieth of the twenty-four courses in the service of the house of Jehovah. (1 Chronicles 24:16) (B.C. 1014.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님이 강하게 하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 다윗이 성전 봉사 스물넷 반차 중 스무째를 맡긴 제사장이다(역대상 24:16).

entries.definition: (Jehovah lives), “doorkeeper for the ark” at the time of its establishment in Jerusalem. (1 Chronicles 15:24) (B.C. 1043.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와는 살아 계신다'는 뜻으로 언약궤가 예루살렘에 안치될 당시 '궤를 위한 문지기'였다(역대상 15:24).

entries.definition: (treasured of God), a perfectly distinct name from the last. • A man described as father of Gibeon; a fore-father of King Saul. (1 Chronicles 9:35) • One of the sons of Hotham the Aroerite; a member of David’s guard. (1 Chronicles 11:44) (B.C. 1046.) (God lives). • One of the Levites appointed by David to assist in the service of the house of God. (1 Chronicles 15:18,20; 16:5) • One of the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, put to death by his brother Jehoram. (2 Chronicles 21:2,4) (B.C. 887.) • One of the rulers of the house of God at the time of the reforms of Josiah. (2 Chronicles 35:8) (B.C. 623.) • A Gershonite Levite, (1 Chronicles 23:8) who had charge of the treasures. ch. (1 Chronicles 28:8) • A son of Hachmoni named in the list of David’s officers, (1 Chronicles 27:32) as “with the king’s sons,” whatever that may mean. • A Levite who took part in the restorations of King Hezekiah. (2 Chronicles 29:14) (B.C. 726.) • Another Levite at the same period. (2 Chronicles 31:13) • Father of Obadiah, of the Bene-Joab. (Ezra 8:9) (B.C. before 459.) • One of the Bene-Elam, father of Shechaniah. (Ezra 10:2) • A member of the same family, who himself had to part with his wife. (Ezra 10:26) • A priest, one of the Bene-Harim, who also had to put away his foreign wife. (Ezra 10:21) (B.C. 459.)
entries.definition_ko: '하나님께 소중히 여겨진 자' 또는 '하나님은 살아 계신다'는 뜻(앞의 여히야와는 전혀 다른 이름). 여러 동명이인이 있다: (1) 기브온의 아버지로 묘사되는 사울의 조상(역대상 9:35). (2) 아로엘 사람 호담의 아들, 다윗의 근위 용사(역대상 11:44). (3) 다윗이 하나님의 집 봉사를 돕도록 임명한 레위인(역대상 15:18). (4) 유다 왕 여호사밧의 아들로 형제 여호람에게 죽임당함(역대하 21:2). (5) 요시야 개혁 당시 하나님의 집 지도자 중 하나(역대하 35:8). (6) 게르손 가문 레위인으로 보물 관리(역대상 23:8). (7)~(10) 그 외 여러 동명이인.

entries.definition: (a Jehielite), according to the Authorized Version a Gershonite Levite of the family of Laadan. (1 Chronicles 26:21,22)
entries.definition_ko: '여히엘 사람'이라는 뜻으로 라단 가문 게르손 레위인이다(역대상 26:21).

entries.definition: (Jehovah strengthens), son of Shallum, one of the heads of the tribe of Ephraim in the time of Ahaz. (2 Chronicles 28:12) comp. 2Chr 28:8,13,15(B.C. 738.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 강하게 하신다'는 뜻으로 아하스 시대 에브라임 지파 지도자, 살룸의 아들이다(역대하 28:12).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah adorns), one of the descendants of Saul. (1 Chronicles 8:36)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 꾸미신 자'라는 뜻으로 사울의 후손 중 하나이다(역대상 8:36).

entries.definition: (Whom Jehovah adorns), queen to King Josiah, and mother of Amaziah of Judah. (2 Kings 14:2; 2 Chronicles 25:1) (B.C. 862-837.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 꾸미신 자'라는 뜻으로 요아스의 왕비이자 유다 왕 아마샤의 어머니이다(열왕기하 14:2).

entries.definition: (whom the Lord sustains). • The son and successor of jehu, reigned 17 years, B.C. 856-840, over Israel in Samaria. His inglorious history is given in (2 Kings 13:1-9) Throughout his reign, ver. (2 Kings 13:22) he was kept in subjection by Hazael king of Damascus. Jehoahaz maintained the idolatry of Jeroboam; but in the extremity of his humiliation he besought Jehovah, and Jehovah gave Israel a deliverer—probably either Jehoash, vs. (2 Kings 13:23) and 2Kin 13:25Or Jeroboam II., (2 Kings 14:24,25) • Jehoahaz, otherwise called Shallum, son of Josiah, whom he succeeded as king of Judah. He was chosen by the people in preference to his elder (comp. (2 Kings 23:31) and 2Kin 23:36) brother, B.C. 610, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. Pharaoh-necho sent to Jerusalem to depose him and to fetch him to Riblah. There he was cast into chains, and from thence he was taken into Egypt, where he died. • The name given, (2 Chronicles 21:17) to Ahaziah, the youngest son of Jehoram king of Judah.
entries.definition_ko: '주께서 붙드시는 자'라는 뜻. (1) 예후의 아들, 이스라엘 왕(주전 856~840년경). 재위 내내 수리아 왕 하사엘에게 압제당했으나 여호와께 간구해 구원자를 얻었다(열왕기하 13:1). (2) 요시야의 아들, 살룸이라고도 불리며 형보다 백성의 선택을 받아 즉위했으나(주전 610년) 석 달간 통치 후 바로느고에게 폐위되어 애굽로 끌려가 그곳에서 죽었다. (3) 유다 왕 여호람의 막내아들 아하시야에게 붙여진 다른 이름(역대하 21:17).

entries.definition: (given by the Lord), the uncontracted form of Joash. • The eighth king of Judah; son of Ahaziah. (2 Kings 11:21; 12:1,2,4,6,7,18; 14:13) [Joash, 1] • The twelfth king of Israel; son of Jehoahaz. (2 Kings 13:10,25; 14:8,9,11,13,15,16,17) [Joash, 2]
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 주신 자'라는 뜻, 요아스의 축약되지 않은 형태. (1) 유다 여덟째 왕, 아하시야의 아들(열왕기하 11:21). (2) 이스라엘 열두째 왕, 여호아하스의 아들(열왕기하 13:10).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah gave), a name of which John is the contraction. • A Korhite Levite, one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle. (1 Chronicles 26:3) comp. 1Chr 25:1(B.C. 1014.) • One of the principal men of Judah under King Jehoshaphat. (2 Chronicles 17:15) comp. 2Chr 17:13and 2Chr 17:19(B.C. 910.) • Father of Ishmael, one of the “captains of hundreds” whom Jehoiada the priest took into his confidence about the restoration of the line of Judah. (2 Chronicles 23:1) (B.C. 910.) • One of the Bene-Bebai who was forced to put away his foreign wife. (Ezra 10:28) (B.C. 459.) • A priest, (Nehemiah 12:13) during the high priesthood of Joiakim. ver. (Nehemiah 12:12) (B.C. 406.) • A priest who took part in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 12:42) (B.C. 446.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 주신 자'라는 뜻, 요한의 축약되지 않은 형태. (1) 고라 가문 레위인, 성막 문지기(역대상 26:3). (2) 여호사밧 시대 유다의 주요 인물(역대하 17:15). (3) 이스마엘의 아버지, 제사장 여호야다가 유다 왕통 회복을 위해 신뢰한 백부장(역대하 23:1). (4) 이방인 아내를 내보낸 브네베배 가문(에스라 10:28). (5) 요야김 대제사장 시대 제사장(느헤미야 12:13). (6) 예루살렘 성벽 봉헌에 참여한 제사장(느헤미야 12:42).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah has appointed), son of Jehoiakim, and for three months and ten days king of Judah. (B.C. 597.) At his accession Jerusalem was quite defenseless, and unable to offer any resistance to the army which Nebuchadnezzar sent to besiege it. (2 Kings 24:10,11) In a very short time Jehoiachin surrendered at discretion; and he, and the queen-mother, and all his servants, captains and officers, came out and gave themselves up to Nebuchadnezzar, who carried them, with the harem and the eunuchs, to Babylon. (Jeremiah 29:2; Ezekiel 17:12; 19:9) There he remained a prisoner, actually in prison and wearing prison garments, for thirty-six years, viz., till the death of Nebuchadnezzar, when Evilmerodach, succeeding to the throne of Babylon, brought him out of prison, and made him sit at this own table. The time of his death is uncertain.
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 정하신 자'라는 뜻으로 여호야김의 아들, 3개월 10일간 유다 왕으로 통치했다(주전 597년). 즉위 당시 예루살렘은 무방비 상태였고 느부갓네살 군대에 곧 항복했다. 왕과 왕대비, 신하들이 바벨론으로 끌려갔으며 그곳에서 36년간 옥에 갇혀 지내다가 느부갓네살이 죽고 에윌므로닥이 즉위하면서 감옥에서 나와 왕의 식탁에서 함께 식사하게 되었다. 죽은 시기는 알려지지 않았다.

entries.definition: (Jehovah knows). • Father of Benaiah, David’s well-known warrior. (2 Samuel 8:18) 1Kin 1and 2 passim ; (1 Chronicles 18:17) etc. (B.C. before 1046.) • Leader of the Aaronites, i.e. the priests; who joined David at Hebron. (1 Chronicles 12:27) (B.C. 1053-46.) • According to (1 Chronicles 27:34) son of Benaiah; but in all probability Benaiah the sons of Jehoiada is meant. Probably an error in copying. (1 Chronicles 18:17; 2 Samuel 8:18) • High priest at the time of Athaliah’s usurpation of the throne of Judah, B.C. 884878, and during the greater portion of the forty-years reign of Joash. He married Jehosheba; and when Athaliah slew all the seed royal to Judah after Ahaziah had been put to death by Jehu, he and his wife stole Joash from among the king’s sons and hid him for six years in the temple, and eventually replaced him on the throne of his ancestors. [Athaliah] The destruction of Baal-worship and the restoration of the temple were among the great works effected by Jehoiada. He died B.C. 834. • Second priest, or sagan, to Seraiah the high priest. (Jeremiah 29:25-29; 2 Kings 25:18) • Son of Paseach, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem. (Nehemiah 3:6)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 아신다'는 뜻. (1) 다윗의 유명한 용사 브나야의 아버지(사무엘하 8:18). (2) 헤브론에서 다윗에게 합류한 아론 자손(제사장)의 지도자(역대상 12:27). (3) 아달랴의 찬탈 시기(주전 884~878년경) 대제사장으로 여호세바와 결혼했고 아하시야가 예후에게 죽임당한 후 아달랴가 왕실 씨를 모두 죽이려 하자 요아스를 왕자들 중에서 훔쳐내 6년간 성전에 숨겼다가 결국 조상의 왕좌에 복위시켰다. 바알 숭배 근절과 성전 회복이 그의 큰 업적이었다. 주전 834년경 죽었다. (4) 대제사장 스라야의 부제사장(예레미야 29:25). (5) 바세아의 아들, 예루살렘 옛 문 보수를 도움(느헤미야 3:6).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah sets up), called Eliakim, son of Josiah and king of Judah. After deposing Jehoahaz, Pharaoh-necho set Eliakim, his elder brother, upon the throne, and changed his name to Jehoiakim, B.C. 608-597. For four years Jehoiakim was subject toi Egypt, when Nebuchadnezzar, after a short siege, entered Jerusalem, took the king prisoner, bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon, and took also some of the precious vessels of the temple and carried them to the land of Shinar. Jehoiakim became tributary to Nebuchadnezzar after his invasion of Judah, and continued so for three years, but at the end of that time broke his oath of allegiance and rebelled against him. (2 Kings 24:1) Nebuchadnezzar sent against him numerous bands of Chaldeans, with Syrians, Moabites and Ammonites, (2 Kings 24:7) and who cruelly harassed the whole country. Either in an engagement with some of these forces or else by the hand of his own oppressed subjects Jehoiakim came to a violent end in the eleventh year of his reign. His body was cast out ignominiously on the ground, and then was dragged away and buried “with the burial of an ass,” without pomp or lamentation, “beyond the gates of Jerusalem.” (Jeremiah 22:18,19; 36:30) All the accounts we have of Jehoiakim concur in ascribing to him a vicious and irreligious character. (2 Kings 23:37; 24:9; 2 Chronicles 36:5) The reign of Jehoiakim extends from B.C. 609 to B.C. 598, or, as some reckon, 599.
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 세우시는 자'라는 뜻, 본명 엘리아김, 요시야의 아들이자 유다 왕. 여호아하스를 폐위한 바로느고가 형 엘리아김을 왕위에 앉히고 이름을 여호야김으로 바꿨다(주전 608~597년경). 4년간 애굽에 복속했다가 느부갓네살이 짧은 포위 끝에 예루살렘에 들어가 왕을 사로잡아 바벨론으로 끌고 가려 하고 성전 기물 일부도 시날 땅으로 가져갔다. 느부갓네살에게 조공을 바치다가 3년 후 반역했고(열왕기하 24:1) 갈대아·수리아·모압·암몬 군대의 잔혹한 침탈을 겪었다. 재위 11년째 폭력적으로 죽어 시신이 '나귀처럼 매장'되어 예루살렘 성문 밖에 던져졌다(예레미야 22:18). 재위는 주전 609~598(또는 599)년까지이다.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah defends), head of the first of the twenty-four courses of priests. (1 Chronicles 24:7)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 방어하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 제사장 스물넷 반차 중 첫째 반차의 우두머리이다(역대상 24:7).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah impels) and Jon’adab, the son of Rechab, founder of the Rechabites, an Arab chief. When Jehu was advancing, after the slaughter of Betheked, on the city of Samaria, he was suddenly met by Jehonadab, who joined with him in “slaying all that remained unto Ahab.” (2 Kings 10:15-17)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 재촉하시는 자'라는 뜻으로 레갑의 아들, 레갑 족속의 시조이자 아랍 족장이었다. 예후가 벧에겟 학살 후 사마리아로 진군할 때 갑자기 만나 '아합에게 속한 모든 자를 죽이는' 일에 함께했다(열왕기하 10:15).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah gave). • Son of Uzziah; superintendent of certain of King David’s storehouses. (1 Chronicles 27:25) (B.C. 1014). • One of the Levites who were sent by Jehoshaphat through the cities of Judah, with a book of the law, to teach the people. (2 Chronicles 17:8) (B.C. 910.) • A priest, (Nehemiah 12:18) the representative of the family of Shemaiah, ver. 6, when Joiakim was high priest. (B.C. after 536.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 주신 자'라는 뜻. (1) 웃시야의 아들, 다윗 왕의 일부 창고 감독(역대상 27:25). (2) 여호사밧이 율법책을 가지고 유다 성읍들을 순회하도록 보낸 레위인 중 하나(역대하 17:8). (3) 요야김 대제사장 시대 스마야 가문 대표 제사장(느헤미야 12:18).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah has exalted). • Son of Ahab king of Israel, who succeeded his brother Ahaziah B.C. 896, and died B.C. 884. The alliance between the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, commenced by his father and Jehoshaphat, was very close throughout his reign. We first find him associated with Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom in a war against the Moabites. The three armies were in the utmost danger of perishing for want of water. The piety of Jehoshaphat suggested an inquiry of Jehovah, thorough Elisha. After reproving Jehoram, Elisha, for Jehoshaphat’s sake, inquired of Jehovah, and received the promise of an abundant supply of water, and of a great victory over the Moabites; a promise which was immediately fulfilled. The allies pursued them with great slaughter into their own land, which they utterly ravaged and destroyed most of its cities. Kirharaseth alone remained, the there the king of Moab made his last stand. An attempt to break through the besieging army having failed, he resorted to the desperate expedient of offering up his eldest son, as a burnt offering, upon the wall of the city, in the sight of the enemy. Upon this the Israelites retired and returned to their own land. (2 Kings 3:1) ... A little later, when war broke out between Syria and Israel, we find Elisha befriending Jehoram; but when the terrible famine in Samaria arose, the king immediately attributed the evil to Elisha, and determined to take away his life. The providential interposition by which both Elisha’s life was saved the city delivered is narrated (2 Kings 7:1) ... and Jehoram appears to have returned to friendly feeling toward Elisha. (2 Kings 8:4) It was soon after these vents that the revolution in Syria predicted by Elisha took place, giving Jehoram a good opportunity of recovering Ramoth-gilead from the Syrians. he accordingly made an alliance with his nephew Ahaziah, who had just succeeded Joram on the throne of Judah, and the two kings proceeded to occupy Ramoth-gilead by force. The expedition was an unfortunate one. Jehoram was wounded in battle, and obliged to return to Jezreel to be healed of his wounds. (2 Kings 8:29; 9:14,15) jehu and the army under his command revolted from their allegiance to Jehoram, (2 Kings 9:1) ... and hastily marching to Jezreel, surprised Jehoram, wounded and defenseless as he was. Jehoram, going out to meet him, fell pierced by an arrow from Jehu’s bow on the very plot of ground which Ahab had wrested from Naboth the Jezreelite; thus fulfilling to the letter the prophecy of Elijah. (1 Kings 21:29) With the life of Jehoram ended the dynasty of Omri. • Eldest son of Jehoshaphat, succeeded his father on the throne of Judah at the age of 32, and reigned eight years, from B.C. 893-2 to 885-4. As soon as he was fixed on the throne, he put his six brothers to death, with many of the chief nobles of the land. He then, probably at the instance of his wife Athaliah the daughter of Ahab, proceeded to establish the worship of Baal. A prophetic writing from the aged prophet Elijah, (2 Chronicles 21:12) failed to produce any good effect upon him. The remainder of his reign was a series of calamities. First the Edomites, who had been tributary to Jehoshaphat, revolted from his dominion and established their permanent independence. Next Libnah, (2 Kings 19:8) rebelled against him. Then followed invasion by armed bands of Philistines and of Arabians, who stormed the king’s palace, put his wives and all his children, except his youngest son Ahaziah, to death, (2 Chronicles 22:1) or carried them into captivity, and plundered all his treasures. he died of a terrible disease. (2 Chronicles 21:19,20)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 높이신 자'라는 뜻. (1) 아합의 아들, 이스라엘 왕으로 형 아하시야를 이어 즉위(주전 896년경), 주전 884년경 죽음. 유다와의 동맹이 부왕 때부터 이어져 여호사밧과 모압을 상대로 함께 전쟁했다(열왕기하 3:1). 나중에 아람과의 전쟁에서 엘리사의 도움을 받았으나 사마리아 대기근 때는 오히려 엘리사를 죽이려 했다(열왕기하 7:1). 라못길르앗 원정에서 부상당해 이스르엘로 후송되었다가 예후에게 살해되어 나봇의 밭에서 죽어 엘리야의 예언이 문자 그대로 성취되었다(열왕기상 21:29). 그의 죽음으로 오므리 왕조가 끝났다. (2) 여호사밧의 맏아들로 32세에 즉위해 8년간 다스렸다(주전 893~885년경). 즉위하자마자 여섯 형제와 귀족들을 죽였고 아내 아달랴(아합의 딸)의 영향으로 바알 숭배를 도입했다. 늙은 선지자 엘리야의 편지도 그를 돌이키지 못했다. 에돔이 반역해 독립했고 립나도 반역했으며 블레셋·아라비아 연합군이 침입해 왕궁을 약탈하고 막내아들 아하시야를 제외한 모든 아들과 아내들을 죽이거나 사로잡았다. 끔찍한 병으로 죽었다(역대하 21:19).

entries.definition: (whose oath is Jehovah). (2 Chronicles 22:11) [See Jehosheba]
entries.definition_ko: '여호와는 나의 맹세'라는 뜻(역대하 22:11). 여호세바(JEHOSHEBA) 항목 참조.

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah judges.) • King of Judah, son of Asa, succeeded to the throne B.C. 914, when he was 35 years old, and reigned 25 years. His history is to be found among the events recorded in (1 Kings 15:24; 2 Kings 8:16) or in a continuous narrative in (2 Chronicles 17:1; 2 Chronicles 21:3) He was contemporary with Ahab, Ahaziah and Jehoram. He was one of the best, most pious and prosperous kings of Judah, the greatest since Solomon. At first he strengthened himself against Israel; but soon afterward the two Hebrew kings formed an alliance. In his own kingdom Jehoshaphat ever showed himself a zealous follower of the commandments of God: he tried to put down the high places and groves in which the people of Judah burnt incense, and sent the wisest Levites through the cities and towns to instruct the people in true morality and religion. Riches and honors increased around him. He received tribute from the Philistines and Arabians, and kept up a large standing army in Jerusalem. It was probably about the 16th year of his reign, B.C. 898, when he became Ahab’s ally in the great battle of Ramoth-gilead, for which he was severely reproved by Jehu. (2 Chronicles 19:2) He built at Ezion-geber, with the help of Ahaziah, a navy designed to go to Tarshish; but it was wrecked at Ezion-geber. Before the close of his reign he was engaged in two additional wars. He was miraculously delivered from a threatened attack of the people of Ammon, Moab and Seir. After this, perhaps, must be dated the war which Jehoshaphat, in conjunction with Jehoram king of Israel and the king of Edom, carried on against the rebellious king of Moab. (2 Kings 3:1) ... In his declining years the administration of affairs was placed, probably B.C. 891, in the hands of his son Jehoram. • Son of Ahilud, who filled the office of recorder of annalist in the courts of David, (2 Samuel 8:16) etc., and Solomon. (1 Kings 4:3) • One of the priests in David’s time. (1 Chronicles 15:24) • Son of Paruah; one of the twelve purveyors of King Solomon. (1 Kings 4:17) • Son of Nimshi and father of King Jehu. (2 Kings 9:2,14)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 심판하신다'는 뜻. (1) 유다 왕, 아사의 아들, 35세에 즉위(주전 914년경)해 25년간 통치했다. 아합·아하시야·여호람과 동시대였으며 솔로몬 이래 가장 훌륭하고 경건하며 번영한 왕 중 하나였다. 아합과의 동맹을 맺었으나 라못길르앗 전투 참여로 예후에게 크게 책망받았다(역대하 19:2). 아하시야와 함께 다시스로 가는 배를 만들었으나 에시온게벨에서 파선했다. 암몬·모압·세일 연합군의 위협에서 기적적으로 구원받았다. (2) 아힐룻의 아들, 다윗과 솔로몬의 사관(사무엘하 8:16). (3) 다윗 시대 제사장(역대상 15:24). (4) 바루아의 아들, 솔로몬의 열두 지방관 중 하나(열왕기상 4:17). (5) 님시의 아들이자 예후 왕의 아버지(열왕기하 9:2).

entries.definition: (valley of the judgment of Jehovah), a valley mentioned by Joel only, as the spot in which, after the return of Judah and Jerusalem from captivity, Jehovah would gather all the heathen, (Joel 3:2) and would there sit to judge them for their misdeeds to Israel. ch. (Joel 3:12) The scene of “Jehovah’s judgment” as been localized, and the name has come down to us attached to that deep ravine which separates Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, through which at one time the Kedron forced its stream. At what period the name “valley of Jehoshaphat” was first applied to this spot is unknown. It is not mentioned in the Bible or Josephus, but is first encountered in the middle of the fourth century. Both Moslems and Jews believe that the last judgment is to take place there. The steep sides of the ravine, wherever a level strip affords the opportunity, are crowded—in places almost paved— by the sepulchres of the Moslems, or the simpler slabs of the Jewish tombs, alike awaiting the assembly of the last judgment. The name is generally confined by travellers to the upper part of the glen. (Others suppose that the name is only an imaginary one, “the valley of the judgment of Jehovah” referring to some great victories of God’s people in which judgment was executed upon the heathen; or perhaps, as Keil, etc., to the end of the world.—ED.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와의 심판의 골짜기'라는 뜻으로 요엘서에만 언급되며 유다와 예루살렘이 포로에서 돌아온 후 여호와께서 모든 이방 민족을 모아 그들의 이스라엘에 대한 악행을 심판하실 곳으로 예언된다(요엘 3:2). 이 이름은 예루살렘과 감람산을 가르는 깊은 협곡(기드론 골짜기)에 붙여졌으나 정확한 시기는 알려지지 않으며 4세기 중반에야 처음 문헌에 등장한다. 무슬림과 유대인 모두 최후 심판이 이곳에서 일어날 것으로 믿는다.

entries.definition: (Jehovah’s oath), daughter of Joram king of Israel, and wife of jehoiada the high priest. (2 Kings 11:2) Her name in the Chronicles is given Jehoshabeath. (B.C. 882.) As she is called, (2 Kings 11:2) “the daughter of Joram, sister of Ahaziah,” it has been conjectured that she was the daughter, not of Athaliah, but of Joram by another wife. She is the only recorded instance of the marriage of a princess of the royal house with a high priest.
entries.definition_ko: '여호와의 맹세'라는 뜻으로 이스라엘 왕 요람의 딸이며 대제사장 여호야다의 아내이다(열왕기하 11:2). 역대기에서는 여호사브앗으로 표기된다. 왕실 공주가 대제사장과 결혼한 유일한 기록이다.

entries.definition: (whose help is Jehovah; Help of Jehovah or savoiur). In this form is given the name of Joshua in (Numbers 13:16) Once more only the name appears,—as Jehosh’uah.
entries.definition_ko: '그 도움은 여호와'라는 뜻으로 민수기 13:16에서 여호수아 이름이 이 형태로 나온다.

entries.definition: in the genealogy of Ephraim. (1 Chronicles 7:27)
entries.definition_ko: 에브라임 족보에 나오는 표기이다(역대상 7:27).

entries.definition: (I am; the eternal living one). The Scripture appellation of the supreme Being, usually interpreted as signifying self-derived and permanent existence. The Jews scrupulously avoided every mention of this name of God, substituting in its stead one or other of the words with whose proper vowel-points it may happen to be written. This custom, which had its origin in reverence, was founded upon an erroneous rendering of (Leviticus 24:16) from which it was inferred that the mere utterance of the name constituted a capital offence. According to Jewish tradition, it was pronounced but once a year, by the high priest on the day of atonement when he entered the holy of holies; but on this point there is some doubt. When Moses received his commission to be the deliverer of Israel, the Almighty, who appeared in the burning bush, communicated to him the name which he should give as the credentials of his mission: “And God said unto Moses, “I AM THAT I AM (ehyea asher ehyeh); and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.” That this passage is intended to indicate the etymology of Jehovah, as understood by the Hebrews, no one has ventured to doubt. While Elohim exhibits God displayed in his power as the creator and governor of the physical universe, the name Jehovah designates his nature as he stands in relation to man, as the only almighty, true, personal, holy Being, a spirit and “the father of spirits,” (Numbers 16:22) comp. John 4:24Who revealed himself to his people, made a covenant with them, and became their lawgiver, and to whom all honor and worship are due.
entries.definition_ko: '나는 스스로 있는 자'라는 뜻으로 지고하신 존재를 가리키는 성경적 칭호이며 통상 자존적이고 영원한 존재를 뜻하는 것으로 해석된다. 유대인들은 이 이름을 언급하는 것을 극도로 꺼려 다른 단어(주로 모음점이 같은 단어)로 대체했는데, 이는 레위기 24:16의 오독에서 비롯된 관습으로, 이 이름을 발음하는 것 자체가 죽을죄라고 오해한 데서 나왔다. 유대 전승에 따르면 대제사장이 대속죄일에 지성소에 들어갈 때 1년에 단 한 번만 발음되었다고 한다. 모세가 이스라엘 구원자로 부름받을 때 하나님이 떨기나무 불꽃 가운데서 '나는 스스로 있는 자'(에흐예 아셰르 에흐예)라는 이름을 계시하셨다. 엘로힘이 창조자·통치자로서의 하나님을 나타낸다면 여호와는 사람과의 관계 속에서 유일하신 전능하고 참되고 인격적이며 거룩하신 존재, 영이시며 '영들의 아버지'로서 자기 백성에게 자신을 계시하고 언약을 맺으며 율법을 주신 분을 가리킨다.

entries.definition: (Jehovah will see or provide), the name given by Abraham to the place on which he had been commanded to offer Isaac, to commemorate the interposition of the angel of Jehovah, who appeared to prevent the sacrifice, (Genesis 22:14) and provided another victim.
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 보시리라(예비하시리라)'는 뜻으로 아브라함이 이삭을 바치라 명령받은 장소에 붙인 이름이다. 여호와의 사자가 나타나 제사를 막고 다른 희생물을 예비하신 것을 기념한다(창세기 22:14).

entries.definition: (Jehovah my banner), the name given by Moses to the altar which he built in commemoration of the discomfiture of the Amalekites. (Exodus 17:15)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와는 나의 깃발'이라는 뜻으로 모세가 아말렉 격퇴를 기념해 쌓은 제단에 붙인 이름이다(출애굽기 17:15).

entries.definition: (Jehovah (is) peace), or, with an ellipsis, “Jehovah the God of peace.” The altar erected by Gideon in Orphrah was so called in memory of the salutation addressed to him by the angel of Jehovah, “Peace be unto thee.” (Judges 6:24)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와는 평강'이라는 뜻으로 기드온이 오브라에 세운 제단의 이름이며 여호와의 사자가 그에게 '너는 평안할지니라' 하신 인사를 기념한다(사사기 6:24).

entries.definition: (whom Jehovah gave). • A Korhite Levite, second son of Obed-edom, and one of the porters of the south gate of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David. (1 Chronicles 26:4,15) compared with Nehe 12:25 (B.C. 1014.) • A Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of King Jehoshaphat. (2 Chronicles 17:18) (B.C. 910.) • Son of Shomer or Shimrith, a Moabitish woman, who with another conspired against King Joash and slew him in his bed. (2 Kings 2:21; 2 Chronicles 24:26) (B.C. 837.)
entries.definition_ko: '여호와께서 주신 자'라는 뜻. (1) 고라 가문 레위인, 오벧에돔의 둘째 아들, 다윗 시대 성전 남문과 곳간의 문지기(역대상 26:4). (2) 여호사밧 시대 베냐민 사람, 18만 무장병의 지휘관(역대하 17:18). (3) 모압 여인 소멜(시므릿)의 아들로 다른 자와 함께 요아스 왕을 침상에서 살해함(열왕기하 12:21).

entries.definition: (Jehovah justifies), usually called Jozadak or Josedech. He was the son of the high priest Seraiah. (1 Chronicles 6:14,15) When his father was slain at Riblah by order of Nebuchadnezzar, (2 Kings 25:18,21) Jehozadak was led away captive to Babylon. (1 Chronicles 6:15) (B.C. 588.) He himself never attained the high priesthood, but he was the father of Jeshua the high priest, and of all his successors till the pontificate of Alcimus. (Ezra 3:2; Nehemiah 12:26), etc.
